news.Title: 台股衝高後漲勢收斂　終場上漲81點創收盤新高
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘智義台北2026年9月22日電）美股那斯達克創高，帶動台股今天盤中漲近900點，突破今年6月23日48218.87點前波高點，創下48601.53點新高；不過在長假前賣壓調節下，指數漲勢收斂，終場上漲81.33點，收在47800.17點，創台股收盤新高。

加權指數終場收在47800.17點，漲81.33點，漲幅0.17%，成交金額新台幣1兆215.69億元。

台積電 (2330) 盤中上攻至2510元，終場由紅翻黑下跌20元，收在2460元；聯發科 (2454) 收5180元，漲170元；台達電 (2308) 收1900元，漲25元。（編輯：張良知）

news.Title: 台股盤中噴新高！台塑化破85元能加碼嗎　股人曝指標：買進台塑四寶需要勇氣
news.Content:
台股近來表現強勢。示意圖，與新聞個案無關。（資料照，中央社）

台股9月以來震盪幅度不小，但近期明顯轉強，今（22）日，受美股科技股大漲帶動台股跳空開高，加權指數開盤上漲262.2點，以47,981.04點開出，隨後漲勢進一步擴大，盤中一度衝上48,601.53點，漲幅超過800點，改寫盤中新高。台積電開盤也上漲25元、報2505元。股人阿勳今則臉書以「台塑化起死回生後！？」為題指出，就股價而言，台塑化（6505）從2025年股價最低一度剩30元，短短一年重新站回85元，翻了快3倍，猶如「起死回生」。

台塑四寶股價表現？

9月中旬這一波，塑化股明顯受到油價、塑化報價及8月營收成長等題材帶動，尤其9月17日台塑四寶同步大漲，其中，台塑化（6505）則是四寶近期波動最明顯的一檔。股價走勢盤點如下：

台塑（1301）： 9月14日收62.9元，15日跌至62元，之後連續反彈，9月17日收64.6元、單日漲3.53%，9月18日65元，9月21日再收65.2元，從9月15日低點到21日收盤已反彈約5.16%。

南亞（1303）： 9月15日曾跌至221.5元，16日反彈至224元，17日再大漲5.36%至236元，18日收238元，21日則來到239.5元。也就是說，從9月15日低點到21日，股價已回升約8.1%。

台化（1326）： 9月14日收67.6元，15日跌至65.8元，16日持平，17日大漲4.26%至68.6元；不過18日、21日又稍微拉回，21日收67.8元。這檔近期走勢比較像是「急漲後整理」。

台塑化（6505）： 9月9日受到8月營收年增50.3%等消息激勵，股價單日大漲9.92%、收87.5元；之後回檔，9月11日跌至83.6元，9月17日又大漲7.08%至86.2元，18日收86.5元，21日則收88.5元。從9月11日低點到21日已反彈約5.9%。

台塑化基本面改善？

股人阿勳分析，台塑化此次並非單純股價上漲，就連基本面也出現明顯改善；就財報來看，8月營收819.06億元，年增50.29%，已是6個月營收增加，獲利方面今年從2025年第二季ROE（股東權益報酬率）-1.89%，到今年第二季已達到14.62%。他指出，背後最大的功臣就是煉油事業，除了原油價格因中東戰事提高外，關鍵是全球成品油供給受到干擾，讓煉油利差大幅改善，「價格好＋產量回來」，自然讓獲利快速復甦。他提醒，然而，關鍵是台塑化的產業競爭力是否也同步回升，因為中國產能讓​亞洲石化產業​供過於求的結構性問題仍然存在。

台塑化為何股價大漲？

​股人阿勳表示，他認為此次台塑化獲利大幅改善，因是煉油景氣加地緣政治紅利，大於公司競爭力出的質變，這也是河流圖顯示台塑化目前仍在「偏低」區間、但高估甚至到167元的原因，他會比較保守看待，因最危險的估值方式，就是拿景氣高峰的獲利去乘上一個正常本益比。他總結，台塑化站上85元還能不能漲，這不是重點，而是當地緣政治降溫後，台塑化一年到底還能賺多少？如此才能判斷85元是便宜，還是市場已經反映得差不多了，「現在買台塑四寶需要很大的勇氣」。​

news.Title: 聯發科、創意股價繼續創新高　但台股見4萬8後外資反手賣超、台積電收盤反跌
news.Content:
台股22日一度飆高到4萬8千多點，隨後法人賣出台積電，竟然拉出801點的上影線，收盤漲幅剩下0.17%，收在47800.17點。（圖片來源／信傳媒資料照）

22日凌晨美股大漲，台指期夜盤一路漲上4萬8千點，果然台北股市以跳高242點、47981點開出，隨即直奔48601.53點，最高漲幅1.81％，在外資一路賣出的情況下，收盤卻回到4萬7千點，收在47800.17點，僅小漲0.17％，差點白忙一場，成交量1.02兆元。

股王台積電（2330）也是開高，開2505元，隨即來到盤中高點2510元，距離歷史新高2535元僅差25元，之後持續走低，到11點半過後沒多久就翻黑，然後便一路在平盤以下，最後收在2460元，下跌0.81％。

股王先盛後衰，台積電不漲反跌

隨著台積電的反轉，早盤多檔強勢上漲的個股也開始收斂，最明顯是記憶體族群，南亞科（2408）早盤最高漲到533元，強漲3.29％，沒想到台積電還沒翻黑，南亞科9點22分後就先翻黑了，最後收在497元，反跌3.68％。

華邦電（2344）早盤最高漲到180.5元，強漲3.74％，11點40分後全面翻黑，最後收在171元，反而下跌3元。旺宏（2337）早盤最高漲到123.5元，強漲2.92％，11點40分後全面翻黑，最後收在118元，跌1.67％。

晶圓代工族群也相同，聯電（2303）盤中最高漲到168.5元，但到了尾盤剩下161元，漲幅收斂為％，盤終收在160元。世界先進（5347）也一度漲到181.5元，到了1點20分左右股價173元，最後收在173元。

聯發科和創意續創歷史新高價，矽光子全面下跌

但聯發科（2454）依然延續昨天漲勢，今天續創歷史新高，盤中一度漲到5480元，漲幅9.38％，最後漲幅雖然收斂，但仍大漲130元，收在元。受到聯發科的激勵，ASIC股創意（3443）開盤瞬間亮燈漲停，鎖死在8375元一路到收盤，再創歷史新高。

矽光子族群也是紅翻黑，聯亞（3081）早盤還漲到2950元，大漲75元，隨後翻黑，最後收在2830元，反而下跌45元。華星光（4979）震盪更為劇烈，早盤還漲到618元，大漲3％以上，數次翻黑再翻紅，11點5分左右出現今日次高價位629元，許多股民追價，最後反而下跌2.1％ 收在605元。

(原始連結)

news.Title: 台股衝歷史新高卻後繼無力！終場小漲81點　台積電收2460元
news.Content:
即時中心／綜合報導

受AI人工智慧巨頭股價上漲的提振，加上油價與美債殖利率回落，美股週一（21日）大幅收高。台股今（22）日開盤後迅速攀高突破4萬8大關，指數來到48,601.53點、大漲882.69點，突破今年6月23日盤中創下的48,218.87點歷史最高紀錄。然而盤中漲勢一路滑落，終場指數就以47,800.17點作收、小漲81.33點，漲幅0.17％，成交量1兆215.69億。台積電（2330）終場收在2,460元、下跌20元。

電子權值股方面，鴻海（2317）收253元，漲3元；聯發科（2454）收5,180元，上漲170元；廣達（2382）收342元，跌2.5元；台達電（2308）以1,900元，漲25元；日月光投控（3711）收693元，上漲30元；聯電（2303）收160元，漲3元；大立光（3008）漲5元，收在6,405元。

金融方面，富邦金（2881）收154.5元平盤價；國泰金（2882）收在112元，跌1元；中信金（2891）跌0.8元，以69.6元作收；兆豐金（2886）收在50.5元，下滑0.6元；華南金（2880）跌0.1元，收在46.55元；第一金（2892）收39.9元，漲0.15元；合庫金（5880）跌0.15元，以27.05元作收。

今日成交量前10名個股依序友達、群創、聯電、彩晶、南茂、華邦電、力積電、和益、中石化、南亞。此外，漲幅前五名為稜研科技*-創、創意、高力、嘉晶、景碩；至於跌幅前五名則為光鋐、天瀚、惠特、聚鼎、東訊。

news.Title: 電子權值與高價股輪漲，推升指數創歷史新高
news.Content:
【財訊快報／方亞申】美國費半指數週一大漲，以CPU為主的英特爾、AMD、ARM週一全面上漲超過9%以上，晶片股普遍走高。指標美國10年期公債殖利率跌回具有重要心理意義的5%關口之下、布蘭特原油期貨盤中跌破每桶100美元等激勵，美股四大指數週一全面大漲，那指創收盤歷史新高，刺激台股週二開盤後衝歷史新高48,601點。電子高價股信驊(5274)、創意(3443)、聯發科(2454)及矽智財股主攻，封測、面板、ABF等紛紛上漲，不過隨著台積電(2330)由紅翻黑，指數漲幅收斂，終場上漲81.33點，收在47800.17點，成交量1兆215.69億元。沉寂已久的Meta，於9月初推出Muse，可在後台代替使用者預訂旅行、管理行程及購物。據統計Muse已連續3天位居美國iPhone免費App下載榜首，ChatGPT排名第2，Google Gemini居第8，Claude則降至第22。

Muse快速竄紅，也刺激META股價週一大漲11.3%。隨著AI從問答走向實際操作，推論及基礎設施工作負載將增加，進而推升CPU需求，使得三家CPU公司AMD、ARM、英特爾股價都大漲，ARM上漲17%、英特爾上漲12%。

Meta平台新推出的消費級AI智能體Muse迅速走紅，也令市場重新評估智能體普及帶來的運算需求，帶動CPU概念股全面上揚。META股價大漲11%、AMD上漲9%，收在651美元，總市值首度突破1兆美元。Meta目前是AMD第2大客戶，貢獻約5.5%營收。雙方今年2月宣布擴大合作，Meta計劃部署最多6GW的AMD Instinct GPU，首批支援1GW部署的產品預計2026年下半年出貨，並採用以MI450架構為基礎的客製化晶片。Arm預估2030年市場規模可達1,200億美元；AMD則上看2,200億美元。英特爾執行長陳立武上周也表示，公司目前僅能滿足約50%的客戶需求，CPU供應緊張仍將持續。這次半導體主軸轉向CPU。

此外，谷歌、亞馬遜、輝達等高總市值公司股價也緩步上升。那指這次創收盤歷史高點，一反今年以來的弱勢。短線只要四大指數站穩10日線上就屬強勢。

台股8月份以來除少數電子股向上推升之外，有台塑集團及金融股掩護推升，9月以後又轉換成電子股。這次晶圓代工的台積電、聯電(2303)、世界(5347)表現都不錯。矽智財則由高價股創意創高，聯發科跟進，信驊股價也登上2萬元創高，川湖(2059)、大立光(3008)、漢測(7856)、世芯(3661)、力旺(3529)、台光電(2383)以及ABF的欣興(3037)、南電(8046)、臻鼎(4958)、景碩(3189)，加上散熱的富世達(6805)、健策(3653)表現都不錯。

封測族群強勢，日月光(3711)續勢挑戰前波的歷史高價，矽格(6257)、力成(6239)、欣銓(3264)、華東(8110)、京元電(2449)、南茂(8150)等都屬強勢。矽晶圓及台積電耗材中砂(1560)、昇陽半導體(8028)、精材(3374)強勢。傳統半導體績優股瑞昱(2379)、聯詠(3034)及廠務的聖暉*(5536)、漢唐(2404)表現也不錯。面板股友達(2409)因為富采(3714)買進大漲，群創(3481)跟進。

油價下跌，加上美中官員對本週四將登場的「川習會」釋放樂觀信號，台塑四寶下跌，記憶體也拉回。金融股富邦金(2881)及國泰金(2882)穩健。

news.Title: 上市櫃逾千家下跌！台股創高後爆賣壓 收盤小漲台積電跌20元
news.Content:
台股今（22日）早盤一度大漲將近900點衝上48601.53點，再創歷史新高，午盤過後出現獲利了結賣壓，漲勢也跟著收斂，下市櫃下跌家數超過千檔，終場台股僅小漲81.33點收在47800.17點，無法守住48K大關，成交量1.02億元。

權值股台積電開高走低，早盤一度大漲30元觸及2510元，盤中翻黑下跌，最終下跌20元收在2460元；聯發科漲勢也略為收斂，盤中一度逼近漲停，最終上漲170元收在5180元，漲幅仍逾3%，台達電最高觸及1965元，終場漲25元收在1900元。

ABF載板表現強勢，欣興、景碩及南電狂飆漲停，臻鼎-KY也上漲超過4%，股王信驊一度漲停鎖在21800元，最終收在20905元，成為台股首檔2萬元個股，友達飆上漲停，彩晶大漲超過4%。電子五哥、記憶體與金融股則有賣壓，資金向少數大型權值股集中。

法人認為，台股創高後難免出現震盪，且中秋連假將至，預期觀望氣氛會轉趨濃厚，若操作偏短線，可以考慮獲利了結，長線投資者仍可汰弱留強，尤其第四季一直都是股市表現較好的時刻。

摩爾投顧分析師林漢偉指出，今日台股挑戰歷史新高，美股全面收漲，加上台指期夜盤大漲728點，電子權值股買氣明顯升溫。外資現貨連三買、期貨空單持續減少，中小型股同步補漲，今天重點觀察指數補量後能否上演軋空行情。

news.Title: 導入台積電2奈米　創意HBM4E矽智財設計定案AI晶片採用
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中新竹2026年09月22日電）特殊應用晶片（ASIC）廠創意電子 (3443) 今天宣布，HBM4E實體層（PHY）與控制器矽智財（IP）已完成設計定案，並獲客戶人工智慧（AI）ASIC採用。

創意今天發布新聞稿表示，旗下HBM4E PHY與控制器IP是採用台積電最先進的強化版2奈米（N2P）製程與CoWoS-L封裝技術。

創意指出，HBM4E IP可將資料傳輸速度提升至16Gbps，同時提供領先業界的功耗效率與超小面積。透過專有的矽中介層（interposer）布線技術，這IP針對訊號完整性與電源完整性進行最佳化，並可支援多種台積電CoWoS封裝架構。

為支援3D系統整合單晶片（SoIC）架構，創意表示，HBM4E IP提供專為台積電SoIC-X技術設計的face-up版本。IP整合專用矽穿孔（TSVs），以支援訊號輸出與輸入，以及向上層晶片提供電源，為複雜的3D整合架構建立完整的連接路徑。

創意指出，HBM4E在頻寬與系統層級效能方面，為新一代AI加速器帶來重大突破。透過整合創意的face-up HBM、face-up UCIe與GLink-3D IP，創意提供完整的3D SoIC架構介面IP解決方案，使客戶能夠無縫整合HBM、小晶片（Chiplet）與3D堆疊，並充分發揮最先進製程技術的效能。

news.Title: 台股選股新浪潮，台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金10/5開募
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】台新投信指出，回顧2026年，市場聚焦權值股，使得台股投資以「買方向」為優先並重壓權值股；展望2027年，台股獲利增速換檔與供應鏈分化，超額報酬核心將由「題材上漲」走向「獲利兌現與企業差異」，將造就台股主動選股新浪潮，ETF資金漸往小股本靠攏，中小股本公司更有表現空間。台新投信率先業界推出國內首檔聚焦中小股本的台股主動式ETF「台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金(00416A)」，將於10月5日開始募集，為投資人掌握中小利基股的長線爆發力行情。台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金經理人沈建宏表示，美國期中選舉將於11月舉行，根據歷史經驗來看，在美國總統任期中，美股在第二年期中選舉前半年呈現低報酬、高波動特徵，但隨著民調逐漸明朗，市場信心在接近選舉日及選後快速修復，加上2027年美股企業獲利持續成長，配合往年大選前一年通常是總統任期內股市表現最佳的一年，預期第四季美股有望重啟漲勢，屆時台股追隨美股節奏，延續2027年的多頭行情。而根據統計，美國期中選舉後三月、六月與一年之台股報酬，股本低於80億的中小型股平均報酬皆優於股本大於80億的大型股。

台新臺灣中小主動式ETF基金是目前國內唯一高度鎖定股本80億以下、基本面強、成長潛力佳的個股的台股主動式ETF。主要是看好小股本籌碼輕，更具股價爆發力，運用經理人洞察好時機，主動挖掘基本面強，未來具成長潛力的小股本公司，完整布局台灣六大AI浪潮優勢產業鏈。沈建宏表示，高盛證券預估，AI算力需求將以每年約400%的速度爆發式增長，AI仍在成長趨勢上，台股企業獲利2026~2027年增率皆有20%以上的成長，台股後市仍有機會創新高，中小利基股表現可望勝出。

news.Title: 聯發科推個人運算新平台 首款3奈米旗艦晶片導入Googlebook
news.Content:
聯發科(2454-TW)今(22)日推出全新Dimensity個人運算(Compute Experiences；CX)系列平台的首款旗艦SoC Dimensity CX C10 Max，其採用台積電(2330-TW)(TSM-US) 3奈米製程，為即將上市的高階、超便攜Googlebook提供卓越性能、先進功能，以及出色能效。

聯發科Dimensity CX C10 Max 搭載全大核8核心CPU、11核心GPU，以及自家第8代NPU，透過高性能平台架構，在多工任務、生產力應用、智慧輔助、娛樂等多元應用場景中提供優異性能；其節能架構可協助製造商設計出更輕薄、無風扇且具備全天候續航力的裝置。

聯發科NPU 890提供最高可達55 TOPS的性能，讓即將上市的Googlebook能提供更主動且智慧的服務。延續聯發科技橫跨邊緣到雲端的AI技術領導地位，NPU 890專為支援Gemini Intelligence功能設計，不僅帶來更快速的回應速度，也帶來更完善的隱私保護。

聯發科資深副總經理暨數據中心與運算事業群總經理Vince Hu表示，Dimensity CX C10 Max是專為下一波智慧運算需求所打造，透過結合旗艦性能與高能效運算技術，確保在帶來絕佳的使用者體驗的同時，也能擁有優異的電池續航力。透過將這些強大的運算能力擴展至Googlebook，聯發科技不僅彰顯在Android運算領域的領先優勢，更延續與 Google長久以來的深厚合作夥伴關係。

聯發科技Dimensity CX C10 Max整合Imagiq 1090 ISP，提供業界頂尖的專業級相機畫質，該款AI-ISP支援高達3200萬畫素相機感測器，並以此實現高品質HDR影片拍攝、流暢變焦、電影級畫面，以及持續對焦不中斷等功能，為視訊通話、直播、內容創作帶來更清晰、更具沉浸感的體驗。

此平台支援Wi-Fi 7連線，提供高達7.3Gbps的傳輸速度，即便在訊號繁忙的無線環境下，也能為影音串流、下載、視訊會議提供高速可靠的連線品質；此外，也支援雙引擎藍牙6.0，提供無線周邊裝置與音訊設備高效的連線。

Dimensity CX C10 Max透過整合全大核CPU、強勁GPU以及具備Agentic AI加速能力的業界領先NPU，以因應最嚴苛且繁重的運算任務，並賦予使用者超高速多工處理能力，最大化其生產力。

news.Title: 不只台積電受惠！ 瑞銀上修CoWoS產能 一口氣喊買11台廠
news.Content:
雲端AI需求強勁，自研晶片與CPU爆發驅動CoWoS先進封裝產能大擴張！瑞銀最新報告看好台積電、聯發科及設備供應鏈，獲利與目標價全面看升。

雲端AI需求帶動產能升級

根據瑞銀證券最新發布的研究報告顯示，隨著雲端AI晶片需求持續暢旺，特別是各大廠商自研晶片（ASIC）與CPU的量產進程加速，業界對CoWoS先進封裝產能的需求顯著提升。瑞銀預計到2027年底，CoWoS月產能將達到27萬片，超越先前預期的26萬片，相較2026年底的16萬片呈現大幅成長。即便英特爾的EMIB-T與台積電的COPOS逐步量產，CoWoS在大型AI加速器中的不可替代性依然穩固。

客製化晶片突破拉動封裝需求

經過多年的技術投資，各大雲端業者與AI原生企業在客製化晶片領域陸續取得突破。微軟Maia 300效能表現具競爭力，預計產量將大幅上升；OpenAI與Meta也同步調升產量目標。此外，Google TPU與亞馬遜Trainium專案均穩健推進，這些進展進一步拉動了對先進封裝的強勁成長需求。

台廠先進封裝供應鏈全面受惠

在雲端AI半導體供應鏈中，瑞銀首選台積電、聯發科與日月光投控作為核心標的。其中，聯發科不僅提供Google TPU設計服務，更具備強大的新ASIC商機。瑞銀預估包含先進封裝在內的後段製程，將佔台積電2026與2027年營收的12%與16%，其先進封裝營收在2026至2030年間，將維持約50%的年複合成長率。

同時，先進封測設備商與相關供應鏈也直接受惠於產能擴張與封裝結構複雜化。瑞銀看好的台廠業者包含萬潤、弘塑、致茂、鴻勁、信驊及世芯-KY。針對弘塑，瑞銀雖然考量2026年設備交機認列減少與平均售價下修，將其目標價由5000元調降至4300元並下修EPS預測，但考量其仍為先進封裝擴產的主要受惠者，依然維持「買進」評等。

news.Title: 台股再刷盤中新高 登48601點
news.Content:
全球各主要央行升息暫告一段落，市場也逐漸消化「AI末日論」。美股四大指數全面反彈，台北股市今天(22日)一開盤就突破前波高點48,218點，大漲近900點，來到48,601點的新高位，再度改寫歷史盤中新高。

美國最新公布7月CPI數據顯著降溫，引發市場對聯準會按兵不動與未來降息的樂觀預期，美國科技股與亞洲半導體重鎮同步拉開強勢反彈序幕。

根據瑞士銀行(UBS)的研究報告，大幅上調全球AI資本支出預測，預估至2026年全球AI資本支出將逼近1兆美元大關。大華銀投信指數量化投資部門主管郭修誠指出，瑞銀等國際機構上調資本支出預估，證實全球科技巨頭對AI基礎建設的投資絲毫未減，反而因記憶體價格勁揚與設備升級而持續擴大支出規模，不僅奠定未來數年的高成長格局，更將推升AI硬體產業鏈邁向2027年的高速AI黃金期。

在美股四大指數全面反彈激勵下，台北股市22日一開盤就突破前波高點48,218點，大漲近900點，來到48,601點的新高位，再度改寫歷史盤中新高。

萬寶投顧執行長王榮旭也指出，全球各主要央行升息已暫告一段落，日前傳出的「AI末日論」，近期輝達等相關科技AI巨頭都陸續出面釋疑，市場也逐漸消化科技類股利空。以目前來看，各界擔心的通膨，近期在油價回跌，再加上美伊高層有望這週會面，都讓市場情緒轉趨樂觀。且從期程來看，時序邁入第四季，11月初美國又將舉行期中選舉，在外資回流下，台股看來也正逐步挑戰登上5萬點的歷史大關。王榮旭說：『(原音)今天預估量1.1兆是配合指數過前高，所以指數過前高有超過1兆以上的大量，代表就是籌碼在高檔換手的一個狀況是不錯。今天除非尾盤殺下來，要不然的話如果能夠收高就是量價俱揚，配合指數過高以及籌碼良性換手，這是有利行情繼續的往上漲。』

台北金融市場22日呈現股匯雙漲格局。在台股創新高下，新台幣兌美元匯價盤中一度大幅升值近1角，突破31.7元大關，來到31.66元，近午盤時又回到31.7元價位附近游走。

news.Title: 智慧戒指大廠Oura赴美IPO 估值挑戰156億美元
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-22 11:38:32 李彥瑾 發佈

芬蘭智慧戒指大廠Oura 21日正式啟動IPO法人說明會（Roadshow），計劃與現有股東合計出售5,000萬股，每股發行價格區間40至44美元，最高可募資22億美元。若計入已發行股票、認股選擇權等潛在股份的稀釋效果，完全稀釋估值上看156.2億美元。

路透社報導，Oura預計最快下週公布IPO定價，並以股票代號「OURA」掛牌那斯達克交易所。近期因AI題材熱度降溫、美債殖利率走高，加上Fed政策預期反覆，市場風險偏好轉趨謹慎，Oura IPO案也被視為美股IPO市況的重要風向球。

Oura於2013年在芬蘭創立，公司總部位於美國舊金山，主力產品為智慧戒指Oura Ring。相較智慧手錶，智慧戒指體積更小、重量更輕，長時間配戴較無異物感，非常適合用來追蹤心率、睡眠狀況及活動量等健康數據。

隨著健康自主管理風氣盛行，智慧戒指市場近年快速崛起，也挹注Oura營運規模擴張。截至2026年6月30日，Oura付費會員數達500萬人；Oura預估2026會計年度終了將增至570萬人，年增96%。

截至2026年6月30日的12個月期間，智慧戒指Oura Ring銷量累計達360萬枚；截至6月30日的9個月期間，營收達12.1億美元，年增74%。

製藥巨頭禮來（Eli Lilly）已表態有意以不超過1億美元的額度認購股份，投資機構Dragoneer亦有意認購至多3億美元。

news.Title: 【台股盤中】台股創高電子強勢　高價股多檔漲停
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘智義台北2026年9月22日電）美股齊揚，科技股大漲，帶動台股今天早盤漲882點，重新站上48000點大關，最高達48601點，創歷史新高，隨後漲勢稍見收斂。電子股強勢，大型權值股上揚，高價股多檔漲停。

11時13分左右，加權指數為48173點，上漲454點，漲幅0.95%，成交金額新台幣6864億元。

台積電 (2330) 早盤達2510元，漲30元，盤中回到2500元之下。聯發科 (2454) 漲470元至5480元後漲勢收斂，台達電 (2308) 為1965元上揚90元；鴻海 (2317) 達253元，漲3元。

股王信驊 (5274) 跳空漲停達21800元，站上2萬元大關，創台股新紀錄；萬元股川湖 (2059) 盤中達13305元；創意 (3443) 盤中也漲停達8375元；千金股嘉澤 (3533) 、南電 (8046) 、欣興 (3037) 都漲停，分別為1745元、1165元、1120元。

新掛牌高價股漢測 (7856) 盤中達4995元，勁揚逾1.22倍。

面板雙虎轉型跨入微型發光二極體（MicroLED）、先進封裝製程受市場矚目，傳聞英特爾將攜手友達 (2409) 投入先進封裝市場，友達繼昨天漲停，今天盤中也高掛漲停價36.65元；已領先反映一段轉型行情的群創 (3481) 則上揚3.57%至52.2元。

news.Title: 股市Q4表現不俗 近5年台股平均漲幅居全球之冠
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-22 11:07:20 新聞中心 發佈

過完中秋假期後，時序也將進入第四季，第四季在節慶效應加持下，向來為全球傳統消費旺季，過往經驗來看股市表現亦多不俗。統計近五年全球主要股市於第四季平均表現，整體來看漲多跌少，前十強股市平均都有超過3%的表現，當中又以台股表現最佳，加權指數平均漲幅近7.67%，緊接著為美股，標普500指數上漲6.68%亦是亮眼，其他包括日本、法國、韓國等也有好於4%的漲幅，投資人不妨善用相關ETF或基金加以布局，把握投資契機。

主動群益核心50 (00415A)經理人許育誌表示，聯準會於最新FOMC會議中決議升息一碼，結束前(2024)年9月以來的降息循環，決策符合市場預期，市場焦點也重回基本面評估，預期基本面佳的區域與產業仍足以抵禦利率上行風險。鑒於台灣經濟保持穩健，加上AI需求強勁，尤其在企業資本支出持續向上，以及相關應用持續落地下，長期發展明確，台系供應鏈因在當中扮演關鍵技術與零組件生產要角，仍有望持續受惠，故對於台股後市仍正向看待，惟在資金輪動的環境下，建議投資人可運用能靈活調整持股的主動式市值台股ETF來掌握行情。

群益S&P500 (009823)經理人謝明志指出，美國經濟活動持續以穩健步調擴張。儘管地緣政治情勢等因素使經濟前景仍籠罩高度不確定性，但國內支出保持韌性，生產力成長強勁，企業獲利前景仍佳，獲利預估上修的企業範圍持續擴大，顯示基本面與獲利面仍能支持美股表現，而在美股題材多元、資金於各類股間健康輪動下，建議投資人不妨善用廣泛布局各產業的市值型美股ETF來參與行情。其中，追蹤標普500指數因成分股組成廣泛，涵蓋近9九成的美股總市值，布局追蹤該指數的美股ETF形同於布局全產業美股，全方位掌握美股行情。

群益東方盛世基金經理人洪玉婷表示，日本企業獲利展現韌性，排除關稅退還與匯率等一次性因素後，今年4月至6月企業獲利年增約9.3%，銀行受惠於升息、非鐵金屬受惠原物料上漲，AI概念股則受惠AI需求強勁，故市場預期日本今年度企業獲利可望成長近19%，此外，日本企業股票回購金額已達去年全年水準，企業亦持續透過出售交叉持股、提高股利與回購強化股東回饋，外資亦具備回補空間，故在獲利面與資金面都屬正向，且經濟持穩，皆有助於日股表現。

news.Title: 漢測正式掛牌上櫃　承銷價 2,250 元創台股史上新高
news.Content:
【緯來新聞網】半導體測試設備廠漢測（7856）今（22）日正式上櫃掛牌，以每股 2,250 元的承銷價創下台股史上最高紀錄。掛牌之際，漢測也交出亮眼的營收成績單：今年 1 至 8 月累計營收達新台幣 31.70 億元、年增 125.94％，已超越 2025 年全年 24.25 億元的規模；隨客製化產品比重提升，近年獲利成長幅度也高於營收成長。

圖／漢測提供

漢測於 2004 年的成立，深耕半導體測試領域，業務涵蓋探針卡與清潔材料、半導體設備與客製化產品，以及工程服務三大領域，同時也是日系晶圓針測機（Prober）大廠的合作夥伴，負責原廠設備的裝機、移機、改機與技術維護。

漢測總經理王子建表示，公司的服務並非僅止於單次設備交付，而是從設備裝機、客製化套件整合與運轉維護，一路延伸至耗材與模組供應，形成完整的服務鏈；隨客戶廠內設備數量增加，公司也能透過第一線服務經驗掌握需求，逐步將客製化方案轉化為可複製、可量產的標準化產品。

這套服務鏈的背後，是漢測以輕資產策略布建的全球服務網絡，目前已涵蓋台灣新竹與台南、中國蘇州、日本東京與熊本，以及馬來西亞、新加坡與美國。王子建說明，隨全球半導體供應鏈區域化趨勢明確，客戶在美國、日本與東南亞的新產能陸續開出，貼近客戶的工程團隊與應變能力，成為承接需求的重要條件；相較於重資產模式，輕資產布局可降低前期投資，也能更快跟隨客戶腳步落地。

除了既有的晶圓測試業務，漢測近年也把觸角伸向高速記憶體 SLT、先進封裝設備，以及矽光子 CPO（共同封裝光學）測試三項新市場。其中，漢測近期與光子自動化設備業者 ficonTEC 展開合作，鎖定 CPO 由研發走向商業化過程中衍生的測試需求，結合 ficonTEC 在光子自動化與設備整合的技術，以及漢測在晶圓級測試系統組裝、工程支援與 OEM 及 ODM 客製化的能力。

談到這項合作，王子建認為，這展現了雙方在技術能力與實務經驗上的互補：ficonTEC 專注於矽光子測試設備開發，具備光電自動化相關技術；未來雙方將共同因應精密對位、光電整合等矽光子測試挑戰，協助客戶縮短從開發驗證到生產應用的導入時程。

法人分析，隨先進製程、先進封裝與高速傳輸技術持續推升測試複雜度，測試環節在半導體價值鏈中的重要性將持續提升，漢測掛牌後的三大新市場布局，也將是後續觀察其成長動能的重點。

news.Title: 費半狂漲4％ 台股大漲逾8百點衝48601點 中秋前創歷史新高
news.Content:
【緯來新聞網】

美股走揚，費城半導體指數更大漲逾4.3％，四大指數全面收漲，韓股週二也跟著狂歡，在三星電子漲近5%帶動，指數漲逾2%，而台股則在台積電、聯發科、聯電等電子股開盤大漲，台股今（22日）以47981點開出，指數上漲262點，隨後指數持續上漲，一度大漲882點至48601點，一舉越過先前高點48218點，在中秋前夕創下歷史新高。

費半狂飆激勵台股一度大漲882點至48601點，一舉越過先前高點48218點，在中秋前夕創下歷史新高。（圖／緯來財經提供）

在晶圓雙雄掌兵權，AI、 ABF載板、IC設計、矽智財、低軌衛星、矽晶圓、光電等電子股全力衝刺，加上傳產與金融助攻，指數開高走高。台積電（2330）開盤上漲25元來到2505元，最高來到2510元；聯發科（2454）延續上攻動能，大漲超過8％，最高來到5480元；ABF族群欣興（3037）、南電（8046）雙雙亮燈漲停；面板股友達（2409）一度漲停，傳出英特爾有意攜手友達推先進封裝，爆出68萬張大量。

興櫃股王、半導體測試介面廠漢測（7856）也在今日（22日）上櫃，以每股2,250元掛牌，最多上漲逾110％，盤中來到4780元，由於搭上人工智慧（AI）、高效能運算（HPC）晶片測試需求爆發商機，股價表現強勢；今日千金股與萬金股表現火燙，信驊（5274）跳空開高開盤漲停，來到21800元，事台股首檔股價突破2萬元的公司；川湖（2059）也反彈超過3％重回13000元。但老AI股表現相對弱勢，緯創（3231）、緯穎（6669）、廣達（2382）多在盤下震盪。

今年市場條件與過往並不完全相同，包括貨幣政策、利率調整等因素已提前反映，本周還有川習會登場，加上台股先前已經歷大幅修正，市場賣壓相對降低，因此中秋節前出現劇烈反轉的可能性較低。

news.Title: Coinbase開放IPO配售，美國散戶申購新股
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-22 10:43:31 數位內容中心 發佈

加密資產交易平台Coinbase（COIN.US）於2026年9月21日宣布，將向符合資格的美國散戶開放首次公開發行股票配售，讓用戶可在股票於公開市場開始交易前，依發行價格申請認購。

Coinbase表示，符合資格的美國散戶可直接參與相關配售，並在新股正式上市交易前，以發行價提出申請。這項新措施把原本多由機構或特定通路主導的IPO配售機會，延伸至零售用戶基礎，也讓平台既有的用戶入口進一步擴及公開市場交易前的認購環節，擴充現有產品與服務範圍。

news.Title: 聯發科旗艦級Dimensity CX C10 Max晶片上市，強攻高階Googlebook
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者李純君報導】針對NB筆電平台，採台積電(2330)3奈米產出，晶片設計龍頭聯發科(2454)今（22）日推出全新Dimensity個人運算（Compute Experiences；CX）系列平台的首款旗艦SoC－Dimensity CX C10 Max，主要將內建在上市的高階、超便攜Googlebook中。聯發科Dimensity CX C10 Max採用台積電3奈米先進製程，搭載全大核8核心CPU、11核心GPU，以及聯發科第8代NPU，透過高性能平台架構，在多工任務、生產力應用、智慧輔助、娛樂等多元應用場景中提供優異性能；其節能架構可協助製造商設計出更輕薄、無風扇且具備全天候續航力的裝置。

聯發科NPU 890提供最高可達55 TOPS的性能，讓即將上市的Googlebook能提供更主動且智慧的服務。延續聯發科橫跨邊緣到雲端的AI技術領導地位，聯發科 NPU 890專為支援Gemini Intelligence功能設計，不僅帶來更快速的回應速度，也帶來更完善的隱私保護。

聯發科資深副總經理暨數據中心與運算事業群總經理Vince Hu表示，Dimensity CX C10 Max是專為下一波智慧運算需求所打造，透過結合旗艦性能與高能效運算技術，確保在帶來絕佳的使用者體驗的同時，也能擁有優異的電池續航力。透過將這些強大的運算能力擴展至Googlebook，聯發科延續在Android運算領域的優勢，與Google長久以來的深厚合作夥伴關係。

聯發科Dimensity CX C10 Max整合Imagiq 1090 ISP，提供業界頂尖的專業級相機畫質，該款AI-ISP支援高達3200萬畫素相機感測器，並以此實現高品質HDR影片拍攝、流暢變焦、電影級畫面，以及持續對焦不中斷等功能，為視訊通話、直播、內容創作帶來更清晰、更具沉浸感的體驗。

此平台支援Wi-Fi 7連線，提供高達7.3Gbps的傳輸速度，即便在訊號繁忙的無線環境下，也能為影音串流、下載、視訊會議提供高速可靠的連線品質；此外，也支援雙引擎藍牙6.0，提供無線周邊裝置與音訊設備高效的連線。

news.Title: 電子高價、封測、CCL、ABF、面板同步上漲，台股指數領先創新高
news.Content:
【財訊快報／方亞申】美國費半指數大漲，以CPU為主的英特爾、AMD、ARM全面上漲超過9%以上，晶片股普遍上揚，指標美國10年期公債殖利率跌回具有重要心理意義的5%關口之下。布蘭特原油期貨盤中跌破每桶100美元等等，一反過去幾週都是利空較多，四大指數全面大漲，那指創歷史新高，刺激台股週二盤中創歷史新高達48601點。電子股高價及矽智財股主攻，封測、面板、ABF、金控雙雄紛紛上漲，進塑化股拉回，預估成交值量超過1兆，多頭趨勢可望持續進行。Meta平台新推出的消費級AI智能體Muse迅速走紅，也令市場重新評估智能體普及帶來的運算需求，帶動CPU概念股全面上揚。Meta股價大漲11%，AMD上漲9%、收在615美元，總市值首度突破1兆美元。Meta目前是AMD第2大客戶，貢獻約5.5%營收。雙方今年2月宣布擴大合作，Meta計劃部署最多6GW的AMD Instinct GPU，首批支援1GW部署的產品預計2026年下半年出貨，並採用以MI450架構為基礎的客製化晶片。Arm預估2030年市場規模可達1,200億美元；AMD則上看2,200億美元。英特爾執行長陳立武上週也表示，公司目前僅能滿足約50%的客戶需求，CPU供應緊張仍將持續。這次半導體主軸轉向CPU。此外，谷歌、亞馬遜、輝達等高總市值公司股價也緩步上升。那指這次創歷史次高，一反今年以來的弱勢。短線只要四大指數站穩10日線上就屬強勢。

台股8月份以來除少數電子股向上推升外，有台塑集團及金融股掩護推升，到了9月以後又轉換成電子股。這次晶圓代工的台積電(2330)、聯電(2303)、世界(5347)表現都不錯。矽智財則由高價股創意(3443)創高，聯發科(2454)跟進，信驊(5274)股價也登上2萬元創高，川湖(2059)、大立光(3008)、漢測(7856)、世芯-KY(3661)、力旺(3529)、台光電(2383)以及ABF的欣興(3037)、南電(8046)、臻鼎-KY(4958)、景碩(3189)，加上散熱的富世達(6805)、健策(3653)表現都不錯。

封測族群強勢，日月光投控(3711)幾乎創高，矽格(6257)、力成(6239)、欣銓(3264)、東華(8110)、京元電子(2449)、南茂(8150)等都屬強勢。矽晶圓及被動元件以及台積電耗材中砂(1560)、昇陽半導體(8028)、精材(3374)。傳統半導體績優股瑞昱(2379)、聯詠(3034)及廠務的聖暉*(5536)、漢唐(2404)表現也不錯。面板股友達(2409)因為富采(3714)買進大漲，群創(3481)跟進。

油價下跌，加上官員對本週四將登場的「川習會」釋放樂觀信號，油價下跌，台塑四寶下跌，記憶體也拉回。金融股富邦金(2881)及國泰金(2882)穩健上漲。

台股指數領先費半及韓國指數創歷史新高，主要是有強勁本面，目前短中期均線集結在47000點上下，轉為強烈支撐。

news.Title: Sandisk has $93.9 billion in deals: Now comes the hard part
news.Content:
Sandisk (SNDK) has become one of the more unusual beneficiaries of the artificial-intelligence boom.

The company is not making the processors that power AI models. Instead, it is supplying something those systems increasingly need: storage .

This differentiation has grown more significant as AI data centers increase and workloads move to inference, agentic AI, and other applications that demand fast storage and access to massive volumes of data.

Sandisk's recent figures indicate exactly how fast the industry has transformed. The business said sales in the fiscal fourth quarter were $8.97 billion, above the $8.39 billion expected, according to Reuters . Data-center revenue more than quadrupled from the preceding quarter to $2.98 billion.

Sandisk also said it currently has eight long-term contracts for $93.9 billion or more with six clients, Reuters also reported. The average contract period is four years, and the company anticipates that half of the company's output will be under such contracts in fiscal 2027 and two-thirds in fiscal 2028.

That change is built into the stock. Sandisk finished at $1,791.82 on Sept. 18 , up 11% that day and 6.2% the previous session.

But there's a catch: The same AI boom driving Sandisk's growth is tightening NAND supplies, attracting new competitors and forcing memory companies to make difficult decisions about where to allocate capacity.

Sandisk's AI opportunity is becoming a storage story

Sandisk's fiscal 2026 results show why investors are paying attention.

Data center storage has become a major growth pillar , the firm said, and its larger business includes corporate solid-state drives, client storage, and consumer goods.

Q4 FY2026 revenue: $8.97 billion

Q4 data-center revenue: $2.98 billion

Long-term agreements: 8

Customers covered: 6

Contract value: At least $93.9 billion

New buyback authorization: $14 billion

Q1 FY2027 revenue outlook: $10.3 billion to $10.8 billion

The fourth-quarter revenue from data centers of $2.98 billion is particularly important because it demonstrates the speed with which the mix is changing.

Related: Micron, SanDisk get new aggressive price targets from top analyst

Data centers need more storage and processing capacity, which is creating demand for Sandisk's enterprise solid-state drives and flash memory chips, Reuters noted.

The projection for the upcoming quarter also suggests ongoing progress for the firm.

Sandisk expects fiscal first-quarter 2027 revenue of $10.3 billion to $10.8 billion , with non-GAAP diluted earnings of $44 to $46 per share.

Story Continues

The NAND market is giving Sandisk more pricing power

Sandisk is experiencing a very timely growth period in the NAND cycle.

North American cloud-service providers had lately revised upward their predictions for business SSD demand. The research group anticipates that enterprise SSD orders will surpass already-high third-quarter levels in the fourth quarter.

Increased demand is also giving NAND suppliers more influence over capacity allocation and pricing, which supports future hikes in enterprise SSD costs, as TrendForce reported.

The enterprise/consumer storage split is now seeping into the wider market.

TrendForce's latest NAND research says AI adoption and cloud investment are driving enterprise SSD demand higher, while consumer electronics demand remains sluggish.

Its prediction for 2027 in September lays out the division even more clearly: Business SSD demand is likely to grow on AI workloads, while consumer NAND is likely to see further cost pressure and increasing Chinese competition.

This creates an appealing product combination for Sandisk.

Enterprise clients purchasing storage for AI infrastructure may support higher-value goods and longer-term contracts. PCs and cellphones are consumer products; therefore, they confront a distinct demand environment.

That's one reason Sandisk has been moving capacity into business storage.

Sandisk is spending billions to stay ahead

Sandisk is not using the present NAND scarcity as an excuse to sit back.

At its August investor day, the business shared a long-term development plan focused on its NAND technological roadmap, customer alliances, and capital allocation.

Sandisk aims to return 100% of surplus cash to shareholders after investing in the company. It has also been investing with Kioxia in innovative memory technologies.

In August, the businesses announced a high-performance 2-terabit QLC 3D flash technology for AI and data-intensive applications.

According to Sandisk tests, Sandisk's next-generation BiCS10 technology is intended to boost memory density by 60%, improve read and write bandwidth by 100%, and increase interface performance by 33% compared to BiCS8.

The company has also authorized a $14 billion share-repurchase program , taking its total remaining authorization to $15.5 billion.

That combination of capacity and technology investment with aggressive shareholder returns lies at the heart of the Sandisk story.

Sandisk's $93.9 billion of commitments creates a new challenge

Long-term contracts might have given Sandisk more insight on future income.

They also generate a delivery obligation.

In fact, NAND supply has become a key concern for the whole semiconductor industry.

Chinese memory startup CXMT is aiming to join NAND flash, possibly adding another rival to a market currently dominated by Samsung Electronics , SK Hynix , Micron Technology (MU) , and China's YMTC, Reuters reported Sept. 18.

Reuters also reported that SK Hynix's Solidigm unit is considering a U.S. NAND manufacturing facility, although no final decision has been made.

Those developments illustrate how valuable NAND capacity has become.

Sandisk is responding through its partnership with Kioxia. The two companies confirmed plans in August to invest more than $31 billion in Japan through 2032 , including a new memory-production facility at Kioxia's Kitakami plant.

Sandisk is reacting via a cooperation with Kioxia, Reuters noted. In August, the two firms said they will spend more than $31 billion in Japan until 2032, including a new memory manufacturing facility at Kioxia's Kitakami factory.

The stock has already priced in a lot of the AI boom

There's one more thing investors can't ignore: valuation.

Sandisk was split from Western Digital in February 2025 and began trading independently under the symbol SNDK.

The stock has surged in an amazing fashion. In August, Reuters reported that Sandisk shares had surged about 470% from the same time in 2026.

Historical market statistics show the stock rose to $1,791.82 on Sept. 18.

That means the question has changed.

Investors are no longer simply asking whether AI will increase demand for NAND storage.

They are asking whether Sandisk can convert that demand into durable revenue, margins, and cash flow quickly enough to justify the expectations already embedded in the stock.

Sandisk's next chapter is about execution

Sandisk has several things working for it. Fast-expanding data center revenue. Long-term customer commitments. Better enterprise SSD demand. New NAND technology. And a big approved repurchase.

But the market is changing, too.

Capacity will increase with time. Chinese competitors are becoming bigger. Other memory vendors are boosting their exposure to corporate SSDs. And Sandisk needs to keep spending while honoring the promises it has already made to its clients.

Sandisk is a vertically integrated NAND flash corporation with chip design, intellectual property, manufacturing, and systems engineering skills, according to the company's own filings.

So far, the figures tell us that AI is generating a powerful new demand driver for storage.

The difficult issue is how long the present scarcity of supply will endure and how much of that economics Sandisk can hold on to.

Sandisk has visibility to long-term deals totaling $93.9 billion. The next task is to translate that visibility into sustainable revenues while not losing its advantage as the NAND market becomes tougher.

news.Title: 友達「兩大利多」再飆漲停！11萬張搶掛還能追？分析師揭關鍵指標
news.Content:
面板大廠友達今（22）日爆量再攻第二根漲停，目前委買張數逼近12萬張，資金簇擁推升盤中成交量逼近85萬張，高居台股個股成交量之冠。市場聚焦英特爾積極布局半導體先進封裝市場，傳出有意與友達合作；此外，先前傳出有意購入友達中科5代、7.5代廠的台積電，也可能攜手友達共同推動先進封裝業務，在雙重利多題材激勵下，友達股價強勢上攻。

籌碼面同樣受到市場關注，外資昨日大買友達逾23.5萬張，自營商也買超約2.2萬張；此外，大戶持股比率也持續攀升，從8月底約41.85%，提高至9月18日的45.71%，顯示市場資金近期明顯回流面板股。

面板三虎今日延續強勁漲勢，除友達攻上漲停外，群創股價來到52元，上漲逾2%；彩晶也同步走強，股價來到15.95元，上漲逾3%。

大來投顧分析師周弘表示，從友達近期股價上漲的背景來看，市場反映的焦點未必完全來自公司實質營收及基本面表現，資產處分同樣是受到市場關注的因素之一。友達近一年積極處分廠房資產，累計交易金額達347億元，且台積電也曾購入友達位於中科的兩座廠房，市場因此持續關注公司透過資產活化所帶來的資金效益。

周弘指出，從技術面來看，帶量突破壓力區通常被視為股價轉強的重要訊號，但若成交量在短時間內急遽放大，後續仍須觀察量價結構能否延續。對於已持有友達的投資人而言，在今日成交量大幅放大的情況下，可持續觀察後續量價表現；若未來連續數個交易日仍無法延續量能並推升股價，則須留意今日大量是否反映短線獲利了結或高檔籌碼轉手，並視後續走勢重新評估操作策略。

至於尚未進場的投資人，周弘建議，考量友達今日成交量已大幅放大，可先觀察後續股價震盪及籌碼沉澱情況，不宜僅因單日爆量突破就急於追價。若後續量價表現屬於健康換手，待股價整理後，再觀察是否出現新的攻擊訊號。

news.Title: 英飛凌、德儀等國際大廠連番漲價，功率半導體進入高景氣週期
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】中國《證券時報》報導，AI數據中心帶動電源管理、高壓MOSFET及其他功率元件需求快速成長，全球功率半導體大廠今年已展開多輪調價，產業由先前去庫存階段轉向供應吃緊，景氣循環明顯升溫。海外大廠英飛凌(德股代碼IFX)、德州儀器(美股代碼TXN)、意法半導體(美股代碼STM)及安森美(美股代碼ON)均已調高部分產品價格。其中，英飛凌針對AI伺服器電源及車用功率元件的部分報價調升10%至20%，意法半導體功率元件交期一度拉長至52週，安森美則預期高價環境可延續至2027年。

財通證券指出，這一輪漲價與2021年通路商投機囤貨不同，主要增量來自海外整合元件製造商(IDM)主動提高原廠庫存，以因應實際供應缺口。瑞薩電子更把成品、裸晶圓及原材料的整體庫存目標，由120天提高至150天，顯示廠商對需求延續性及供應緊張程度的判斷已出現結構性轉變。

台灣供應鏈亦醞釀第三波調價，強茂(2481)、台半(5425)、德微(3675)及尼克森(3317)最快自10月起，針對部分非合約或現貨產品調漲10%至15%。其中，強茂產能接近滿載，部分訂單能見度延伸至2027年中；台半則持續擴充數據中心用MOSFET及高壓二極體產品線，AI機櫃功率密度提高，成為本輪功率半導體景氣上行的主要推力。

news.Title: 「雙龍搶珠」友達亮燈創六年新高價 8萬多張排隊買不到 分析師保守點出轉折
news.Content:
友達（2409）爆出「雙龍搶珠」！轉型半導體先進封裝有成，包括英特爾、台積電（2330）都上門搶合作，連續二天漲停，盤中一度站36.65元寫下2010年2月、逾六年多來新高價，鎖漲停並高掛8萬多張買單排隊買不到，成為盤面一大亮點。同為面板雙虎之一群創（3481）今早小漲逾2%，漲勢不如友達。分析師、啟發投顧副總李永年今早接受《Yahoo股市》採訪提醒，雖技術籌碼面仍有利多方，但基本面未跟上，爆量終場若不能鎖住漲停，恐有人藉機出貨下車。

傳台積電有意取得友達中科5代、7.5代2座廠房，未來不排除攜手推動先進封裝相關業務。英特爾則是聚焦Micro LED基板先進封裝，二大半導體廠不同理由紛紛找上友達合作，讓面板廠聲勢看俏，加上股價相對便宜，股價連番急漲，今早盤中一度攻上36.65元，不僅是今年最高價，是去年底價格的將近3倍之多，亦改寫2020年2月以來的新高價。

籌碼面方面，繼昨天爆出81萬大量後，今早不到一小時就有近76萬成交，同時鎖8萬多張排隊等買。外資昨天狂買23.5萬張，高居買超第一位，亦吸引散戶跟進搶買。

基本面友達今年第2季才成功轉虧為盈，歸屬母公司淨利13.4億元，每股純益（EPS）0.18元，毛利率13%左右。友達積極布局Micro LED、矽光子、CPO與車用應用，公司日前法說會展望第3季，友達表示，消費性電子市場需求仍偏弱，不過車用業務需求維持平穩，垂直場域業務則可望延續穩健成長。

葉憶如／財經特派記者組長，主跑金管會、金控壽險、航空等

news.Title: LG攜微軟擴大AI結盟，樂金電子早盤大漲4.20%、LG控股升2.34%
news.Content:
【財訊快報／陳孟朔】外電報導，韓國LG集團控股公司LG Corp.(韓股代碼003550)週二宣布，與微軟(Microsoft，美股代碼MSFT)擴大戰略合作，範圍涵蓋AI數據中心基礎設施、企業AI轉型及實體AI。消息刺激LG Corp.早盤漲2.34%至11.39萬韓元，樂金電子(LG韓股代碼066570)大漲4.20%至21.1萬韓元。LG集團會長具光謨與微軟董事長兼執行長納德拉(Satya Nadella)，週一在美國華盛頓州雷德蒙德的微軟總部舉行高層會議並簽署戰略合作協議。LG電子、LG Uplus(韓股代碼032640)、LG CNS(韓股代碼064400)及LG科技園區等集團高層均出席會議。

在AI數據中心領域，雙方將結合LG電子的大型冷卻與暖通空調技術、LG新能源(韓股代碼373220)的儲能系統，以及LG CNS的數據中心設計、建造和營運能力，爭取微軟全球數據中心擴建計畫的供應商資格。短期將聚焦大容量冷卻設備，中長期則擴大至可快速建置及擴充的預製式數據中心。

雙方亦將在製造及物流現場推動實體AI，利用LG累積的工業數據及微軟Azure雲端與AI平台，建立把現場數據回饋至模型訓練的「數據飛輪」。這項合作使LG有機會由家電與電子製造商，進一步切入全球AI基礎設施供應鏈；微軟則可取得涵蓋冷卻、電力、儲能及IT建設的一站式數據中心解決方案。

news.Title: 不只台積電爽吃！AI狂潮燒到成熟製程 「二哥」漲價傳聞四起
news.Content:
AI熱潮持續席捲全球，市場關注焦點不再只有台積電2奈米、CoWoS與HBM，投資達人「股人阿勳」21日在 粉專 發文指出，AI產業需求可能正沿著供應鏈向外擴散，甚至開始帶動成熟製程需求升溫，晶圓代工產業供需變化浮上檯面。

股人阿勳表示，近期一項值得注意的訊號，是成熟製程晶圓代工也出現價格調整預期。他指出，聯電近期接單狀況轉強，若目前供需趨勢延續，2027年晶圓代工價格調整的幅度與全面性，可能較今年下半年更加明顯。聯電預估本季晶圓出貨量季增高個位數百分比，產能利用率已突破90%，毛利率則維持在30%中段。

另一方面，市場近期傳出力積電部分晶圓代工產品醞釀調漲，最高幅度甚至上看40%。不過，股人阿勳也特別提醒，40%目前仍屬業界傳聞，力積電並未證實具體漲幅，僅表示目前客戶需求相當強勁，因此後續仍須觀察實際報價與接單情況。

他分析，這波成熟製程需求回升，與過去手機、PC庫存回補的模式並不完全相同。隨著AI伺服器持續擴大，除了GPU、HBM及CoWoS之外，周邊還需要電源管理IC、MCU、感測器、MOSFET及其他功率元件。尤其AI伺服器功耗提高，不只是晶片數量增加，相關零組件規格也同步升級，使AI需求逐步從先進製程向成熟製程外溢。

股人阿勳認為，台積電將更多資源投入先進製程，也可能釋放部分成熟製程訂單，讓聯電、世界先進及力積電等業者有機會承接。接下來市場可觀察三項指標，包括產能利用率能否維持90%以上、平均銷售價格（ASP）是否真正上升，以及漲價能否反映在毛利率。

他指出，如果只有市場傳出漲價消息，卻沒有帶動獲利改善，可能仍屬題材；若產能利用率、ASP與毛利率同步改善，則代表成熟製程供需可能出現更實質的變化。

news.Title: vivo X500系列正式發表，供應鏈聯發科、台積電受惠
news.Content:
【財訊快報／記者劉居全報導】vivo昨（21）日於上海正式發表全新影像旗艦X500系列，首度導入全新「藍圖動態影像技術架構」，X500 Pro與X500 Pro Max全球首發搭載台積電(2330)2奈米製程的聯發科技(2454)天璣9600 Pro旗艦晶片，標準版X500則搭載聯發科技天璣9600M晶片，台廠供應鏈包含台積電、聯發科都將受惠 vivo X500系列新機上市，vivo X500系列將於9月24日起於中國開賣，台灣預計於10月中旬正式發表，實際上市資訊與產品規格將以台灣市場正式公告為準。vivo X500系列聚焦動態拍攝體驗，支援17EV超高動態範圍、業界首發4K 240fps電影級慢動作錄影及8K原生Live動態照片，搭載全球首發聯發科技2nm旗艦晶片天璣9600 Pro，結合自研影像雙晶片V3+與VS1，提供高規格動態影像所需的處理效能。X500 Pro Max更配備CIPA 7.0專業級防手震及3度大角度雲台級光學防手震，強化移動與低光源場景下的拍攝穩定度，從日常記錄、短影音到高規格影片創作，都能以一部手機完成。續航方面，X500 Pro Max配備8,000mAh藍海電池，X500 Pro與X500則分別搭載6,510mAh與7,500mAh電池，從高規格影像創作到日常娛樂使用，都能提供充足電力支援，讓創作不受電量限制。

X500系列持續深化與蔡司（ZEISS）的合作，將專業影像能力帶進更多日常創作場景。X500 Pro Max搭載蔡司2億畫素APO超級長焦鏡頭，支援1,536點多區雷射對焦與最高30倍運動抓拍，並可搭配等效400mm的vivo蔡司增距鏡G2 Ultra，無論演唱會、體育賽事或遠距主體，都能捕捉更多細節。X500 Pro則配備蔡司APO超級長焦鏡頭，主鏡頭與長焦鏡頭均支援CIPA 7.0專業級防手震，兼顧遠距拍攝與移動場景下的穩定表現。

外觀配色方面，X500提供晴天、晨曦、攝夜、大地回聲共四款；X500 Pro提供晴天、覽霞、攝夜、大地回聲四款質感配色。全系列延續X系列標誌性的鏡頭模組與冷雕玻璃工藝，在兼顧大容量藍海電池與旗艦影像硬體的同時，打造俐落輕巧的機身設計，讓高規格影像體驗融入日常，隨手即可開啟創作。

news.Title: 精材Q3營收拚高 Q4續擁動能
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-09-22 09:46:46 王怡茹 發佈

台積電(2330)轉投資封測廠精材(3374)2026年8月自結稅後淨利1.93億元、年增43%，EPS 0.71元；累計7、8月稅後淨利達3.81億元、EPS 1.4元，已逼近第二季整季的EPS 1.46元。展望後市，法人預期，公司9月營收有望維持高檔水準，帶動本季營收改寫新高，獲利則有機會拚同期高點，且在測試新產能全開下，第四季料將延續強勁成長動能。

精材因近期股價多次達公布注意交易資訊標準，故公告8月自結損益。8月營收9.09億元、年增37%，稅前淨利2.39億元、年增43%，歸屬母公司稅後淨利1.93億元、年增43%，EPS 0.71元，較去年同期0.5元成長42%。

若與2026年第二季相比，精材第二季營收21.85億元、稅前淨利4.87億元、稅後淨利3.96億元，EPS 1.46元；8月單月營收約為第二季的42%，但稅後淨利已達第二季整季近49%，顯示單月獲利表現升溫。

近年因CoWoS產能排擠效應，台積電擴大向精材釋出美系手機客戶及其他客戶測試代工訂單，公司也積極擴產支應需求。目前測試服務已成為精材主要成長引擎，第二季測試服務營收13.63億元，季增25%、年增103%，營收占比進一步拉升至62%；上半年測試服務營收則年增109%。

除了測試代工服務外，精材受惠CIS、光感測器等8吋需求好轉，以及手機用8吋光感測器新專案放量，本季即有機會達到滿載。同時，公司也布局車用、穿戴式裝置及顯示器等12吋影像感測器專案，預計2028年大規模放量。

法人認為，精材積極推動既有8吋轉向12吋的產能及製程升級，並已獲得數項新專案肯定。隨測試代工業務進入擴產收割期，後續值得關注公司能否藉由12吋製程升級，在高階3D感測元件取得更多新專案，進一步接棒成為下一波成長動能。

news.Title: 台積電訊號來了？ 魏哲家對蔡力行喊「1句話」股民嗨翻：無腦多
news.Content:
台積電董事長魏哲家近日與聯發科副董事長蔡力行一同出席「榮友會」活動時，當面表示「希望股價趕快趕上聯發科」，引發全場歡笑；相關消息曝光後，也讓股民們熱烈討論台積電與聯發科的股價差距，更有股民幽默表示「訊號來了」。

「榮友會」為台灣高含金量的聯誼組織之一，當天活動，魏哲家率台積電共同營運長秦永沛、米玉傑出席。席間，魏哲家在蔡力行面前展現老友情誼，笑談「希望股價趕快趕上聯發科」，一句話引發現場一陣笑聲。

台積電股價自6月23日創下2535元新高後，歷經7、8月的震盪，今（22）日再度站上2510元高點，而聯發科則創新高來到5480元，兩者股價仍相差2970元。

魏哲家這番話在引發股民熱議，不少網友認為是正面「訊號」，期待台積電股價有更多想像空間，「訊號出現了」、「有預告」、「無腦多」、「該創新高了」。

不過，面對近3000元的價差，也有部分網友持不同看法，股價「趕上」聯發科未必代表台積電股價上升，「聯發科跌到2400也是趕上」、「發哥腰斬也是一種方式」。

此外，也有網友指出，台積電與聯發科在股本、流通股數及市值規模皆有顯著差異，以股價比較存在一定局限，但大多數人仍對魏哲家抱有信心，紛紛留言「我信了」，對台積電未來抱持高度期待。

news.Title: AI算力衝55 TOPS 聯發科推3奈米旗艦晶片搶攻Googlebook
news.Content:
IC設計龍頭聯發科22日宣布，推出全新Dimensity個人運算系列首款旗艦晶片Dimensity CX C10 Max，採用台積電3奈米製程操刀，正式切入Google高階超便攜筆電Googlebook市場，卡位次世代AI筆電商機。

Google甫發表全新旗艦筆電「Googlebook」，首波由宏碁、華碩等品牌操刀的機種已於9月21日啟動預購，預計10月4日陸續出貨，初期以英特爾與高通處理器為主。聯發科則端出旗艦晶片，預告搭載聯發科平台的新機種即將問世，宣告台廠晶片正式打入Google新PC生態圈核心。

Dimensity CX C10 Max採用台積電3奈米製程，配置全大核8核心CPU與11核心GPU，鎖定無風扇、全天候長續航設計。其第8代NPU 890算力高達55 TOPS，超越市場現有同級競品，專為Google終端AI助理Gemini深度優化，可大幅加速運算反應並強化隱私保護，並支援3200萬畫素相機、Wi-Fi 7與藍牙6.0規格。

聯發科資深副總經理暨數據中心與運算事業群總經理Vince Hu指出，該晶片結合旗艦效能與高能效架構，能在帶來絕佳體驗的同時兼顧電池續航力，也深化與Google在個人運算領域的長期合作。

面對英特爾與高通在AI PC領域正面交鋒，聯發科攜手台積電先進製程強勢插旗Googlebook高階生態系，除了開闢智慧型手機以外的營收新動能，也讓台系供應鏈在次世代AI終端洗牌戰中搶占制高點。

news.Title: Why Intel, Arm, and Other AI Chip Stocks Soared Today
news.Content:
Meta Platform 's (NASDAQ: META) new Muse personal artificial intelligence (AI) agent is off to a fast start.

After being the most downloaded free iPhone app in the U.S. for the past three days, according to Sensor Tower, Muse has investors excited about a potential boom in AI agent-fueled sales of central processing units (CPUs).

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

That, in turn, is driving up the stock prices of the leading CPU makers. Here's how some of the top AI chip stocks performed on Monday:

Arm Holdings (NASDAQ: ARM), up 17%

Intel (NASDAQ: INTC), up 12%

Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ: AMD), up 10%

Meta's Muse is grabbing investors' attention

Meta's new AI agent promises to quickly, easily, and securely perform multiple tasks for users, such as sorting email, booking reservations, and managing calendars.

Muse is more accessible than other popular agentic AI projects, such as OpenClaw. It's also backed by Meta's tremendous data collection and distribution capabilities, thanks to the social media giant's staggering 3.6 billion daily active users.

In turn, analysts believe Muse has the potential to attract hundreds of millions of users in the coming months. That would likely make it the most popular AI agent on the market.

AI agents are set to boost demand for CPU makers

While AI model training requires mostly GPU-based compute, agentic AI is powered more by inference, which requires a greater proportion of CPUs to handle tasks like planning and orchestration.

A forthcoming wave of agentic AI-powered applications is thus expected to drive demand for CPUs sharply higher in the coming years. ARM sees the server CPU market surging by 35% annually to $120 billion by 2030, while AMD predicts 50% annual growth to $220 billion by the end of the decade.

As the leading designers of CPUs and related infrastructure, Intel, AMD, and Arm stand to profit handsomely from these trends.

news.Title: AI撐起美股近半獲利成長 高盛警告：明年這股動力恐減弱
news.Content:
高盛( GS-US ) 警告，人工智慧（AI）投資熱潮雖為今年美股企業獲利成長的主要推力之一，貢獻標普500指數成分股近半數的獲利增幅，但隨著企業資本支出增速回落，加上大規模基礎建設投資帶來的折舊費用，將開始侵蝕利潤，這項成長動力預料將自明年起逐步減弱。

儘管瑞銀最新報告預估，全球AI領域投資規模將由今年接近1兆美元，進一步攀升至明年的約1.4兆美元，高盛仍認為，即使企業持續向資料中心及晶片領域投入資金，AI投資熱潮對美股企業獲利成長的拉抬效果也將明顯降溫。

AI基建折舊開始侵蝕獲利

高盛首席美國股票策略師史奈德（Ben Snider）近日在研究報告中指出，根據高盛統計，2026年標普500指數企業的獲利成長中，近50%來自AI投資熱潮。

然而，隨著企業資本支出成長速度放緩，以及大規模AI基礎建設投資產生的折舊費用逐漸反映在財報上，這項有利因素將於明年開始消退。

史奈德表示，AI投資熱潮貢獻今年標普500企業近半數的獲利成長，但即使資本支出持續擴張，相關成長紅利明年仍將開始減弱。

在高盛的基準情境下，美股企業獲利成長不至於完全停滯，但增速將逐步放緩。

史奈德預估，2027年及2028年標普500成分股每股盈餘將分別成長11%，達到415美元及460美元。儘管仍維持兩位數成長，但相較今年第二季每股盈餘大增51%，以及過去四季平均成長26%，已顯著降溫。

晶片價格成美股獲利風險

高盛認為，在各產業當中，半導體業將是美股獲利成長的一大風險。自2022年底AI熱潮興起以來，半導體業一直是大型科技企業加碼AI投資的主要受益者之一。

在需求激增、供給受限的雙重支撐下，全球晶片製造商近年享有極高利潤率，但高盛認為，這種情況恐難長期延續。

史奈德指出，半導體業利潤率近期大幅上升，使標普500企業獲利更容易受到晶片價格下跌衝擊。高盛產業分析師預估，晶片供應至2027年底前仍將維持偏緊，但半導體業利潤率的擴張速度將於明年放緩。

高盛警告，若未來出現AI基礎建設投資降溫、晶片供給增加，或技術迭代壓低晶片價格等不利情境，標普500企業獲利可能受到明顯衝擊。依其估算，在上述情境下，標普500獲利恐縮水約10%。

news.Title: 〈美股盤後〉那指大漲2%創收盤新高 AI股飆升、油價與美債殖利率降溫助攻
news.Content:
美國股市周一(21日)上漲，主要科技股走高，加上油價與美國公債殖利率回落，帶動華爾街從上周大多數指數下跌走勢中反彈。

大盤受到AI相關股票上漲的支撐，費城半導體指數漲逾4%。英特爾(INTC-US)股價大漲12%，AMD(AMD-US)漲近10%，市值達到1兆美元。其他晶片股也表現強勁，例如高通(QCOM-US)漲幅超過9%。

Meta更飆升11.4%。在近期推出Muse AI助理後，富國銀行調高了這家社群媒體公司的目標價，進一步推升股價。

美股周一走高的另一項助力，是美國原油價格大跌4.5%，來到每桶95.78 美元。布蘭特(Brent)原油則下跌3.4%，至每桶 100.34 美元。

油價變化發生在周末中東敵對局勢再度升級之後。獲伊朗支持的葉門武裝組織「青年運動」(Houthis)表示，他們周六以飛彈和無人機攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯。同日稍晚，美國國務院警告美國公民重新考慮前往中東地區旅行，因美國與伊朗相互威脅可能恢復攻擊。

不過，美國與伊朗近期仍有可能展開外交接觸。美國總統川普接受《福斯新聞》訪問時表示，本周聯合國大會期間，他可能願意與伊朗總統Masoud Pezeshkian會面。

隨著油價下跌，美國公債殖利率同步回落。10年期美國公債殖利率下降超過4個基點，來到4.951%。30年期美債殖利率也下降超過4個基點，至5.284%。

news.Title: SanDisk Faces a Make-or-Break Test at $1,832
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

SanDisk Corporation ( SNDK , Financials ) is bumping up against a technical ceiling , as its recent rise runs smack into a critical resistance level.The stock was trading at roughly $1,779 with the last five-hour candle closed at $1,776.11. It nearly touched the $1,832 resistance level at the current high of $1,827.72 which also corresponds to the 61.8% Fibonacci retracement.The trend overall is still to the upside. SanDisk is above its 200-day simple moving average of $1,626.51 and its SuperTrend line of $1,622.34.But there are holes in the momentum. The relative strength index was at 65.57 near an overbought level and average directional index at 21.60, indicating a weak trend. Trading volume has also dropped as the stock approaches resistance.That leaves the $1,832 level as the near-term challenge. A solid five hour close above it, especially on heavier volume would indicate a breakout. Technically, the setup suggests potential targets at $1,980 and $2,100.A refusal would be another matter. A decline below $1,730 with a loss of momentum would indicate that the breakout attempt has failed and focus may turn to lower support levels.So the next catalyst is straightforward: Can SanDisk move $1,832 from resistance to support?

news.Title: Arm Holdings (ARM) Soars 17% on Ambitious $2B Revenue Goal; Hedge Funds Bullish
news.Content: Arm Holdings (NASDAQ:ARM) extended its winning streak to a fifth consecutive day on Monday, jumping as much as 16.8 percent in intraday trading to hit $322, as investors resumed buying positions after management signaled a very strong business performance, saying that demand has "never been stronger." In an interview with CNBC's Jim Cramer last Wednesday, CEO Rene Haas said that demand "is off the charts" for CPUs, GPUs, and memory from data centers, automotive robotics, and edge computing industries. However, he said that the industry may struggle to keep up with the demand, pointing to bottlenecks in wafers, substrates, testing equipment, and memory, among others. For illustration purposes only. Photo from Arm Holdings $2B Emerging Chip Revenue Achievable In this light, Haas said that he has become more confident that Arm Holdings (NASDAQ:ARM) will hit its revenue target of $2 billion for its emerging chip business alone. "So what we said in the earnings call I think was May timeframe that we had visibility to $2 billion, and what we said in the last earnings call was that our confidence to achieve that $2 billion number had increased from May to July," he said. "Here I am in September, and what I can tell you is, Jim, I'm more confident today than I was on that July earnings," he added. "We're feeling good about it. We're feeling really good about it." The comments were significant because investors turned increasingly focused on its ability to turn the ongoing strong demand into revenues, especially as chipmakers continue to compete for limited manufacturing capacity. Arm Holdings (NASDAQ:ARM) first disclosed its $2 billion goal during its May earnings call, double the $1 billion it had outlined when it first announced its first custom CPU in March. In July, management said that its confidence in securing the necessary supply had further improved. Q2 FY2027 Arm Holdings (NASDAQ:ARM) is set to release the results of its earnings performance for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027 ending September on November 4, 2026. For the period, it is targeting total revenues at a midpoint of $1.38 billion, plus or minus $50 million. news.Title: Tech Stocks Break Out: The Next Leg of the Bull Market
news.Content:
After consolidating for roughly four and a half months, the Nasdaq and broader technology sector are finally breaking out of their trading ranges.

That breakout is especially notable given just how much bad news the market has absorbed since the summer. Investors have navigated the blowup of a major AI-focused hedge fund, a sharp correction across the semiconductor industry, growing concerns around the pace and potential disruption of AI development, renewed tensions in the Middle East, and a surge in interest rates toward multi-decade highs alongside a shift toward tighter monetary policy.

And yet, the market has taken it largely in stride.

Certain areas have come under significant pressure at different points, most notably semiconductors, which fell as much as 30% from their highs. But the major indexes have continued to digest each setback without suffering a broader breakdown. Instead, stocks spent the last several months trading in a choppy range just below all-time highs.

Now, that consolidation appears to be resolving to the upside.

Among the strongest technology names leading the market higher today are Arm Holdings (ARM), Intel (INTC), Astera Labs (ALAB) and Meta Platforms (META).

Another notable mover is Strategy (MSTR), formerly MicroStrategy, which is following Bitcoin sharply higher off its recent lows. Strength in both speculative technology stocks and crypto-linked assets is another indication that investors' appetite for risk is beginning to increase again.

After several months of consolidation and repeated tests of investor confidence, the technology sector may finally be entering the next leg of the bull market.

Image Source: TradingView

Why the Breakout in Technology Stocks Matters

The significance of today's move isn't simply that technology stocks are rising. It is what has happened underneath the surface over the last several months.

The semiconductor industry went through a legitimate correction, some of the most crowded AI trades were aggressively unwound, and interest rates moved sharply higher. Just last week, the Federal Reserve raised rates for the first time since 2023, while the 10-year Treasury yield briefly pushed above 5%.

Normally, that combination would be expected to put substantial pressure on long-duration growth stocks, but instead, technology stocks largely consolidated.

That distinction is important. Corrections through time can be just as effective as corrections through price. Rather than collapsing, many of the market's strongest stocks spent the last several months digesting their earlier gains while earnings continued to grow and valuations became less stretched.

Story Continues

Now momentum appears to be returning.

Monday's rally has been particularly strong across AI-related stocks. Intel and Arm Holdings are both surging by double digits, while Advanced Micro Devices, Micron and Meta Platforms are also participating. The Nasdaq is up more than 2.5%, while technology indexes are again pressing toward or through their prior highs.

That is exactly the kind of action investors want to see following an extended consolidation.

The AI Trade Persists Despite Concerns

There has also been an important shift in the AI narrative.

One of the biggest shocks to the trade recently came from the AI industry itself. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei called for the industry to slow the pace of frontier AI development, with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and several other prominent industry leaders subsequently expressing support for greater restraint and oversight. Those comments contributed to a sharp selloff in semiconductor and AI infrastructure stocks as investors worried that a slowdown in model development could eventually mean less demand for chips and data centers.

But I think the market may have taken those comments too literally.

The concerns around AI safety may very well be genuine. However, there is an obvious tension between what industry leaders are saying publicly and what their companies are actually doing.

These businesses remain locked in an intense technological and commercial race. Capital continues to pour into models, compute and data centers, and there has been little indication that the major players are voluntarily stepping away from that competition. There is little if any evidence that there will be any kind of slowdown in the rate of investment and development of the technology.

So while the rhetoric became considerably more cautious, the underlying economics of the AI buildout have not materially changed, which is critically important for investors.

Throughout the summer, the market increasingly questioned the enormous amount of money being poured into AI infrastructure, whether the industry was overbuilding and whether today's leaders could generate adequate returns on that investment. Those remain legitimate questions, but the fundamental evidence still points toward enormous demand for computing power.

Today's strength in Arm and Intel, for example, also highlights how the opportunity is expanding beyond GPUs alone. AI inference increasingly requires CPUs, memory, networking equipment and an enormous amount of supporting infrastructure.

Bitcoin Rally Points to a Return in Risk Appetite

The rebound in Bitcoin offers another useful signal.

Bitcoin has surged sharply off its recent lows, while Strategy and other crypto-linked stocks are moving higher alongside it.

I don't view Bitcoin as a direct indicator of where the stock market goes next. But it is a useful barometer of liquidity and speculative appetite.

Investors spent much of the summer reducing risk. Today, they appear increasingly willing to put it back on.

What Could Go Wrong?

That doesn't mean the market is suddenly without risks.

Interest rates remain historically high, the Fed has shifted toward tighter monetary policy, Middle East tensions remain elevated and valuations across parts of the technology sector are still demanding.

Breadth is also something to watch. Despite Monday's strong index gains, the number of stocks making new lows has recently remained elevated, suggesting that participation beneath the headline indexes is not yet uniformly strong.

So I wouldn't interpret today's breakout as an invitation to blindly chase everything higher.

Instead, I think it reinforces the broader trend that has defined this bull market: investors continue to reward companies producing strong earnings growth and benefiting directly from the enormous capital spending associated with AI.

After more than four months of consolidation, technology stocks now appear ready to test the highs again. If that breakout can hold and participation continues to broaden, it could mark the beginning of the next leg higher in the bull market.

news.Title: Better Artificial Intelligence Stock: Arm Holdings vs. NVIDIA
news.Content:
As artificial intelligence reshapes the global economy, investors can decide between the foundational architecture of Arm Holdings (NASDAQ:ARM) and the powerhouse performance of NVIDIA (NASDAQ:NVDA) to anchor their portfolios for 2026.

Arm designs the underlying blueprints used in nearly every smartphone, while NVIDIA builds the massive graphics processors that power modern data centers. While both are critical players in the chip market, they occupy very different niches in the technology value chain.

The case for Arm

Arm develops the compute platform behind energy-efficient CPU products, making it a leader among semiconductor stocks . Its technology is currently deployed in more than 350 billion chips, providing the architecture for over 99% of the world's smartphones. The company also targets high-growth markets such as cloud computing, networking, automotive, and the internet of things.

In its 2026 fiscal year (FY), revenue reached $4.9 billion, representing growth of 22.8% compared to the previous year. This expansion was supported by a net income of $904.0 million. The company reported a net margin of 18.4%, reflecting a slight decrease from the 19.8% net margin recorded in the prior fiscal year.

As of its March 2026 balance sheet, Arm maintained a current ratio of roughly 6.0x, indicating a strong ability to cover short-term liabilities with its current assets. The debt-to-equity ratio is 0.1x, which compares total debt to the amount of equity held by shareholders. Free cash flow for the period was $979 million. Note that stock-based compensation (SBC) represented roughly 69% of operating cash flow, which inflates reported cash generation since SBC is a non-cash expense added back in the cash flow statement.

The case for NVIDIA

NVIDIA is a full-stack artificial intelligence infrastructure company that serves gaming, professional visualization, and data center markets. In its latest annual report, the company disclosed that two direct customers accounted for 22% and 14% of its FY 2026 revenue. Customer concentration like this adds a layer of risk to the business. Beyond hardware, NVIDIA has expanded its software ecosystem through material developments like the $12.9 billion acquisition of Hugging Face. The company also maintains a long-standing agreement with Microsoft (NASDAQ:MSFT) regarding Xbox and data center infrastructure support.

In FY 2026, revenue reached $215.9 billion, which is a massive 65.5% increase over the $130.5 billion reported in FY 2025. This growth translated into a net income of $120.1 billion. The company achieved an exceptional net margin of 55.6%, a level of profitability that remained remarkably stable compared to the 55.8% net margin seen in the previous year.

Story Continues

Based on its January 2026 balance sheet, NVIDIA carries a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.1x, suggesting a conservative use of borrowed funds relative to shareholder equity. Its current ratio of 3.9x shows that the company has ample liquidity to meet its short-term financial obligations. Free cash flow for the fiscal year was $96.7 billion. Free cash flow measures the cash a company generates after accounting for the money spent on equipment and infrastructure.

Risk profile comparison

Arm faces competition from established players like Intel (NASDAQ:INTC) and Advanced Micro Devices (NASDAQ:AMD), as it tries to gain ground in the data center market. The company also faces risks related to its heavy dependence on the mobile device industry, which can be cyclical. Furthermore, the rise of open-source architectures may provide a low-cost alternative to its licensing model, potentially affecting its ability to maintain its high royalty rates in certain segments.

NVIDIA faces severe operational constraints due to evolving U.S. export controls, particularly those affecting the data center segment in China. The company relies on a fabless manufacturing model heavily concentrated with partners in Asia, exposing it to geopolitical tensions. Additionally, NVIDIA is subject to various international antitrust inquiries and a certified class action securities lawsuit. The rapid pace of product transitions, such as the Blackwell architecture, also presents risks related to potential inventory impairments if demand estimates are inaccurate.

Valuation comparison

NVIDIA appears significantly more attractive on a Forward P/E basis, whereas Arm's high P/S ratio reflects a much steeper premium.

Which stock would I buy in 2026?

Arm Holdings and NVIDIA are great stocks for investors seeking exposure to the hot artificial intelligence sector. Both possess dominant market positions in their respective technologies. However, between the two, I would buy NVIDIA shares.

Certainly, Arm is poised to see further revenue growth. Its new designs to support AI in mobile devices coupled with its expansion into data centers and physical AI systems, such as robots, will fuel future sales.

That said, NVIDIA's secret weapon is its CEO and founder, Jensen Huang. He has successfully anticipated where the AI industry is going over the past several years. From Huang's work years ago with OpenAI to build computing tech specifically for artificial intelligence to his prediction of AI factories that has led to a massive data center buildout around the globe, his vision and leadership has enabled NVIDIA to post exceptional financial performance.

For its next act, the company is working on a platform to support quantum computers. Add to this NVIDIA's far more attractive share price valuation, and this is the stock with the greater upside potential.

news.Title: Meta's Muse Era: Why Arm and AMD Will Soar
news.Content:
Meta Muse Launches

Thus far in the AI buildout, Meta Platforms ( META ) has been one of the biggest big tech spenders on AI infrastructure. Although many Wall Street pundits called Meta's spending reckless, Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg is again showing his ability to see massive trends before the crowd (just like he did with the Instagram and WhatsApp acquisitions). Earlier this month, Meta launched an autonomous personal artificial agent called "Muse."

While legacy chatbots like OpenAI's "ChatGPT" and Anthropic's "Claude" merely answer prompts, Muse is designed to accomplish complex, multi-step tasks. While Muse is brand new, its impact is already being felt. Within a week of its launch, Muse shot to the top of the Apple ( AAPL ) App Store. Meanwhile, over the past month, Meta shares have woken up from a long slumber and have gained 27.4% amid renewed optimism.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

2 Beneficiaries of Meta Muse Success

Arm Holdings

Until recently, NVIDIA ( NVDA ) Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) have dominated the AI market as large language models rely on them for heavy AI training. However, as the agentic AI market grows in popularity, demand for Central Processing Units (CPUs) will soar. CPUs are better suited for agentic AI because they can efficiently handle the continuous, sequential logic it requires.

In March, Meta and Arm Holdings ( ARM ) announced a large-scale partnership to co-develop Arm AGI CPU and multiple generations of specialized silicon for Meta's data centers. According to ARM CEO Rene Haas, Arm already has $2 billion of customer demand for its new AGI CPU. Meanwhile, Zacks Consensus Estimates suggest that Arm will continue to grow revenue and EPS at a double-digit clip through 2028.

Meanwhile, that is not the only bullish news for Arm shares. SoftBank, which owns roughly 90% of Arm's shares outstanding, announced that it would raise Arm's loan facility to $25 billion (from $20B), signaling confidence in the company's prospects. Shares are up more than 10% in early trading and are clearing multi-month resistance.

Image Source: TradingView

Advanced Micro Devices

Because Muse is designed to run locally on computers to avoid cloud token fees, Meta partnered with Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ) to optimize "Muse Glimmer", an open-source model. AMD's chips allow agentic models to run efficiently on consumer PCs. Additionally, the wave of agent demand has driven prices for AMD server chips up ~40%. In a recent interview, AMD CEO Lisa Su said that the server CPU market could exceed $120B by the end of the decade (35% CAGR) as the agentic AI segment gains momentum. Monday, AMD shares broke out to all-time highs as the company crossed the $1 trillion market cap landmark for the first time.

Story Continues

Bottom Line

As the AI landscape transitions from passive chat prompts to autonomous agentic AI, Meta's Muse has gained quick popularity. By powering the data center CPUs and local edge processing required for agentic workflows, Arm Holdings and AMD are positioned to capture immense value.

news.Title: Meta AI agent ‘Muse’ triggers massive tech rally as chips and Wall Street soar
news.Content:
Investing.com -- Technology stocks roared back on Monday, propelled by a powerful rally in Meta Platforms and semiconductor leaders as Wall Street recognized that consumer "agentic" AI may have finally reached a mainstream tipping point.

Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) rallied 6.5% on Monday, leading a broader market advance that lifted the Nasdaq 100 by 2.15%. The frenzy extended deep into the semiconductor sector, with CPU-linked chipmakers staging explosive gains: Arm Holdings (NASDAQ: ARM) surged 15%, Intel (NASDAQ: INTC) jumped 13%, and AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) climbed 9%.

At the center of the surge is growing market optimism surrounding Meta's recently launched consumer AI assistant, Muse. Unlike conventional conversational chatbots, agentic assistants like Muse execute autonomous, multi-step tasks—such as booking travel, managing calendars, and making e-commerce purchases—in the background on behalf of users.

The Agentic Architecture Shift Sparks a CPU Boom

The outsized jump in traditional chip stocks isn't a coincidence. Market intelligence firm Vital Knowledge highlighted to clients that the fundamental architecture required for AI is expanding. While early generative AI workloads relied primarily on heavy GPU acceleration for isolated text and image generation, autonomous agents run continuous background routines, logic loops, and local data orchestration. That makes agentic AI far more CPU-intensive, creating a wildly bullish scenario for companies like AMD, Arm, and Intel as this technology breaks into the mainstream.

Adding fuel to the hardware rally is the growing sense of an industry arms race. Following reports from The Information that OpenAI is scrambling to develop its own Muse-like consumer agent, investors are pricing in a massive, industry-wide rush to bring autonomous capabilities to the consumer market.

All of this sets a highly anticipated stage for Wednesday night, when Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg is scheduled to deliver his keynote address at the annual Meta Connect conference.

SensorTower Data Shows Historic Early Traction

The market's enthusiasm is also being validated by underlying user adoption metrics. In a note to clients on Monday, Wells Fargo analyst Ken Gawrelski raised his price target on Meta from $640 to $796, maintaining an Overweight rating and bumping his 2027 earnings multiple assumption following encouraging signs of a major new product cycle.

Citing data from SensorTower, Gawrelski pointed to an unprecedented download and active user trajectory for the standalone Muse app during its first 12 days in the U.S.:

Story Continues

Record Downloads: The app set a single-day record of 264,000 U.S. downloads on September 19, marking its third consecutive day above the 200,000 threshold.

Daily Active Users (DAUs): Muse hit a new peak of 448,000 DAUs on September 18—just 10 days post-launch.

Historical Comparison: By comparison, OpenAI's ChatGPT required nearly one full year to cross 200,000 daily U.S. downloads, and 49 days to hit 450,000 DAUs.

"Believe Muse assistant and Instinct mark the transition to consumer AI assistants from chatbots," Gawrelski wrote, adding that time-to-market is critical because AI assistants grow more productive the more they are used.

All Eyes on Wednesday Night's Meta Connect

Unlike last year's Connect conference, which focused heavily on smart glasses, analysts expect this year's event to feature heavy product demos of Muse and the underlying "Muse Spark" models. Wells Fargo anticipates Meta will share early commentary on popular consumer use cases, and potentially unveil its much-rumored next-generation large language model, code-named "Watermelon."

On the hardware front, the market is also expecting updates on Meta's wearables division. Press reports suggest the potential release of smart glasses without camera functionality, alongside building anticipation for AI-powered "hearables" (smart headphones) that could further integrate Muse into users' daily lives.

news.Title: Arm Rises 8.8% as Muse Expands AI's CPU Royalty Funnel
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

Arm Holdings ( NASDAQ:ARM ), the processor-architecture licensor, turned Muse's early traction into another powerful AI-compute trade Monday. American depositary shares surged approximately 11.6% to $307.64, extending the market's bet that persistent AI agents could drive far more computing activity than today's chatbot-style workloads. The valuation picture is already aggressive: the shares now sit 58.66% above the $193.90 GF Value estimate, suggesting investors are pricing in substantial future growth.

Barron's cited Arm's estimate that the server-CPU market could reach $120 billion by 2030, with annual growth above 35%. Muse adds another potential demand engine. Unlike a simple AI query that ends when the answer appears, persistent agents can keep browsing, coordinating tasks, handling security checks and running workflows in the background. More autonomous activity means more CPU work sitting around the AI model itself exactly the kind of expanding infrastructure footprint that could enlarge Arm's royalty opportunity.

The catch is attribution. Arm makes money through licensing and royalties tied to partner designs and shipment volumes, so a larger compute market does not automatically translate into Arm revenue. Muse has not disclosed which CPU architecture or infrastructure suppliers power its workloads, leaving the direct connection unproven for now. Investors are therefore paying for a broader thesis: if autonomous agents multiply server workloads and Arm keeps gaining content across data-center designs, royalty growth could follow. At $307.64, however, the stock is already demanding that a meaningful portion of that thesis becomes real.

news.Title: 聚焦川習會 那指飆漲400點 台指期夜盤衝破48K大關
news.Content:
（23：00更新）中美高層會談釋放積極訊號，投資人進一步聚焦即將登場的中美元首「川習二會」，加上油價連續第4個交易日走跌，通膨憂慮暫時緩解，市場情緒轉趨樂觀。周一（21日）美股主要指數開盤同步走高，道瓊工業指數大漲逾300點，那斯達克指數早盤大漲逾400點，與台股連動密切的費城半導體指數開高走高，早盤大漲近3%。台指期夜盤衝破48000點大關，一度飆漲460點，報48513點。

截至台北時間21日晚間10點50分，道瓊工業指數上漲217.81點（或0.42%），暫報51900.45點；那斯達克指數上漲396.457點（或1.50%），暫報26919.002點；標普500指數上漲70.64點（或0.92%），暫報7721.14點；費城半導體指數上漲318.61點（或2.67%），暫報12240.30點。

5大科技巨頭同步走強，蘋果漲0.13%，谷歌母公司Alphabet漲1.67%，微軟漲0.07%，亞馬遜漲0.93%，臉書母公司Meta漲6.68%。半導體類股普遍走高，輝達漲0.93%，超微漲9.33%，台積電ADR漲1.20%，聯電ADR漲2.28%。

美國西德州原油與國際基準布蘭特原油周一同步下跌逾3%。得益於原油價格與美債殖利率雙雙走低，華爾街試圖扭轉上週整體收跌的頹勢。

上周中東局勢再度升級，拖累美股走勢。不過短期內美伊外交談判仍存有可能性。摩根大通分析師近期也指出，儘管近期遭遇擾劫，但原油流通大體尚可維持。

彭博策略師Mark Cranfield將當前市場狀態描述為「金髮女孩情緒」（Goldilocks mood）——原油下跌、股市攀升、國債期貨小幅上行三者共振，並指出此輪行情的催化劑正是中美對話的良好開局。

本周即將舉行的中美首腦峰會備受矚目。雙方會談議題包括AI、關稅、關鍵礦產等多項經濟議題。「川習二會」預計在美東時間24日舉辦。美國財政部長貝森特與大陸國務院副總理何立峰20日已先行在美國紐約進行經貿磋商，貝森特形容雙方的會談「非常成功」。

news.Title: Tech Retakes Lead Heading into Q4: Stocks to Watch
news.Content:
There's an old market adage that says you should watch what stocks do, not what they're supposed to do. Last week offered a textbook case.

On Wednesday, the Federal Reserve raised interest rates for the first time since July 2023 and signaled it isn't finished. The ten-year Treasury yield touched over 5%, its highest level since July 2007. By every piece of conventional wisdom, that combination should have been devastating for stocks.

Instead, the Nasdaq climbed about 2% between the last two sessions of the week, reclaiming its 50-day moving average as investors rotated back into memory and chipmakers. SanDisk surged nearly 11% on Friday to lead the S&P 500. AMD closed within striking distance of its 52-week high.

Heading into the fourth quarter, technology has quietly retaken market leadership — and the reason it's happening in the teeth of a hawkish Fed tells you something important.

What the Fed Actually Did

Let's start with the facts, because the details matter more than the headline.

The FOMC raised its target range 25 basis points to 3.75%–4.00% on a unanimous 12-0 vote. Chair Kevin Warsh was blunt at the press conference: "The plain fact is that inflation is too high and has been for too long." When asked about political pressure for lower rates, he offered only, "We stay in our lane."

The projections did the real damage. Of the 18 officials submitting forecasts, 16 see at least one additional hike this year — twelve expect exactly one more, four expect two, and only two see rates holding here. The median end-2026 dot sits near 4.1%. The committee also raised its core PCE forecast to 3.4% from 3.3% and pushed the expected return to 2% inflation out to 2029.

Warsh, notably, again declined to submit a dot of his own, just as he did in June. That 4.1% median is the committee's view, not the Chair's commitment — which leaves every remaining meeting genuinely data-dependent.

The market's initial reaction was ugly. The Dow fell roughly 600 points on the announcement. But the better characterization of the week is that this was a duration shock rather than a decision shock: the hike itself was priced, and what investors had to reprice was how long rates stay restrictive.

Why Tech Led Anyway

Here's the part that deserves attention. If rising long rates are supposed to compress high-multiple valuations, why did semiconductors lead the rebound?

The answer lies in where our work at Zacks concentrates. Earnings estimate revisions in the semiconductor space have been so strong that they overwhelm the discount-rate math. When analysts raise next year's earnings estimate by 20% or more, a modestly higher discount rate is noise by comparison. Rate-sensitivity arguments assume the earnings stream is fixed. Right now, it isn't.

Story Continues

Energy is also cooling as a competing trade after oil's surge past $100, and the rate-sensitive corners of the market — housing, homebuilders, REITs — have nowhere to hide with the ten-year hovering near 5%. That leaves capital looking for growth that doesn't require cheap money. Semiconductors fit the bill.

Stocks to Watch

Advanced Micro Devices AMD has emerged as the clear second horse in the AI infrastructure race. Shares closed Friday at $559.82, up 2.7% on the session and roughly 161% year-to-date from a January starting point near $215, putting the market capitalization at about $914 billion. That leaves the stock about 4% below its 52-week high — a remarkable recovery as we approach the final quarter of the year.

Image Source: StockCharts

The fundamentals justify the move. Second-quarter revenue rose 50% to $11.54 billion, with Data Center revenue doubling to $6.7 billion and non-GAAP EPS of $1.66 topping consensus. CEO Lisa Su has guided to revenue growth "substantially above 35%" with EPS exceeding $20 over about a 5-year timeframe, underpinned by the Helios rack-scale platform now shipping commercially and GPU commitments from OpenAI, Meta, Oracle, Microsoft and others. AMD is set to report quarterly results in early November.

SanDisk SNDK is the more explosive story. Shares jumped 10.99% Friday to end just under $1,800, leading the S&P 500, and are up more than 650% year-to-date. Two catalysts converged: a structural NAND flash shortage that has handed the company genuine pricing power, and confirmation that SanDisk joins the S&P 100 on Monday, which makes passive index funds mandatory buyers.

Bottom Line

The Fed has told us rates are higher for longer, but the rotation back into tech stocks tells us that the earnings story continues to overwhelm slightly higher rates.

That doesn't make these stocks safe as both carry volatility that accompanies momentum leadership. But with estimate revisions still pointed higher across semiconductors and memory, the path of least resistance heading into the fourth quarter appears to run through technology.

news.Title: Should You Buy Sandisk Stock Now or Wait for a Dip?
news.Content:
Sandisk (NASDAQ:SNDK) has been among the hottest tech stocks to own this year, but it has been slowing down of late. While it's up over 650% since the start of 2026, it is now down about 24% from its 52-week high.

Is now a good time for investors to buy the tech stock , or is it better to wait for an even deeper dip in its price?

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

Image source: Getty Images.

Sandisk stock looks dirt cheap, but only if you trust analyst projections

Although Sandisk's stock is sitting on some significant gains this year, it still doesn't look overvalued based on analyst projections. The company's earnings have been soaring due to inflated demand and prices for memory and storage products. The company sells a wide range of memory cards and storage devices, and its brand is synonymous with not only speed but also reliability.

Demand is expected to remain insatiable, given the investments in artificial intelligence (AI). And according to analysts, the stock is trading at an estimated eight times its future profits, which is absurdly cheap as the average stock on the S&P 500 trades at a forward earnings multiple of around 20.

However, there is always going to be an element of risk due to the uncertainty of what lies ahead, particularly in the tech world, where things can change quickly. If companies scale back or curb AI-related investments, that may lead to a trickle-down effect that impacts the demand for Sandisk's products. Currently, analysts have a rosy outlook for Sandisk, and if that continues to be the case, the stock may indeed surge higher.

Is Sandisk's stock a good buy right now?

Sandisk has generated tremendous returns for investors this year, but when a stock rises so quickly in value, there's also the risk that it can just as quickly give back those gains.

My main concern about the stock is that, while Sandisk's business is doing exceptionally well right now, the outlook may change with the Fed raising interest rates last week and potentially more rate hikes ahead. If companies expect higher rates, that could derail feverish tech spending in the near future. And any hint of a slowdown could spell trouble for a stock such as Sandisk, with much of its valuation dependent on continually strong growth ahead.

I believe the stock may be due for a decline in the latter part of the year, and it may be a more attractive buy then. While it may not seem expensive, Sandisk's stock is still a bit risky at its current valuation .

news.Title: 台積電揪團設先進封裝中心　專家：因應AI迭代速度
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中新竹2026年09月21日電）在台積電號召下，本土設備與材料業者將共同進駐高雄白埔產業園區，推動先進封裝供應鏈發展。半導體專家分析，美國人工智慧（AI）晶片廠技術產品迭代快速，且規格要求不斷升高，使得台積電及其供應商面臨極度挑戰，廠商已無法單打獨鬥，台積電集結設備、材料供應商成立先進封裝驗證中心，可加速技術驗證與供應鏈協作，因應AI快速迭代需求。

為維繫台灣半導體國際競爭力，台積電與經濟部、高雄市政府合作，將高雄白埔產業園區打造為先進封裝設備產業聚落，透過串聯本土廠商進駐，推動先進封裝設備供應鏈與驗證平台。

高雄白埔產業園區今天動土，總統賴清德致詞表示，預計每年創造約新台幣3000億元產值，帶來超過4000個就業機會，為南部半導體生態系補上關鍵拼圖，並為均衡台灣踏出重要一步。

對於台積電號召本土廠商共同進駐產業園區，半導體產業專家指出，美國人工智慧（AI）晶片廠技術產品迭代快速，且規格要求不斷升高，使得台積電及其供應商面臨極度挑戰，廠商已無法單打獨鬥，台積電集結設備、材料供應商成立先進封裝驗證中心勢在必行。

專家進一步說明，台積電透過先進封裝驗證中心可以全面向供應鏈傳達規格技術資訊，不用像過去分別逐一傳達訊息，可減少溝通成本與縮短時間。此外，在技術產品開發時，若遇到問題，也能就近直接溝通解決，無需長途費時往返，有望加速技術產品開發。

換言之，台積電就像是建立共同推進研發的機制，讓各家廠商能夠互信、共享資訊，並在第一時間共同合作，達到共榮目標的關鍵。

台積電近年擴大國際投資布局，不過持續深耕台灣，即便台灣電費自2023年以來已大漲7成，台積電仍在高雄、台中、新竹等地大舉擴充。

產業專家說，考量先進封裝驗證中心成立的急迫性，以及北部土地、水、電資源吃緊情況，在政府協助下，驗證中心順利落腳高雄白埔產業園區。

專家表示，這幾年觀察到，台積電在高雄市政府協助下，於當地迅速建置2奈米產能，預期台積電在高雄白埔產業園區的先進封裝驗證中心相關配套措施，也能夠獲得完善支援。

專家指出，台積電集結台灣設備、材料業者在白埔產業園區，將可加速提升本土供應鏈廠商的技術、能力與能量，合作提供完整先進封裝解決方案，掌握AI快速迭代的商機。

news.Title: 〈美股早盤〉AI與晶片股領漲、油價重挫逾3% 主要指數開高
news.Content: 美股主要指數周一(21日)開盤走高，人工智慧(AI)與晶片股重新上漲，加上美伊談判出現進展跡象，帶動國際油價重挫逾3%、跌至11日低點，舒緩市場對能源價格推升通膨的疑慮。 道瓊工業指數一度大漲逾300點，標普500指數收復本月以來全部跌幅；布蘭特原油連續第4個交易日下挫，創6月以來最長跌勢，美國10年期公債殖利率也降至5%以下。避險情緒降溫之際，比特幣同步攀升至約8.5萬美元。 截稿前， 道瓊工業指數 漲逾 180 點或近 0.4%， 那斯達克綜合指數 漲逾240點或近 0.9%， 標普 500 指數 漲近0.6%， 費城半導體 指數漲近2.1%，台積電ADR漲近1.2%。 美股周一盤前走高，油價連續第4個交易日下跌，加上美中官員在川習會前釋出樂觀訊號，帶動股票與債券同步上漲。標普500指數期貨上漲0.7%，那斯達克100指數期貨勁揚1%，美元持平；美國10年期公債殖利率下滑5個基點至4.95%，比特幣則觸及1月以來新高，推升加密貨幣概念股。 油價回落成為市場風險偏好回升的主要推力。隨著美伊外交斡旋持續，以及中東原油運輸增加，市場對能源價格推升通膨的疑慮略為降溫。美國總統川普表示，本周聯合國大會期間，他「可能」願意與伊朗總統裴澤斯基安(Masoud Pezeshkian)會面。 美軍區域指揮官指出，在美國海軍護航與掃雷行動下，經由荷姆茲海峽運送的原油與液化天然氣已升至6個月來最高水準。另一方面，美中官員也對人工智慧(AI)、貿易及投資談判給予正面評價，替本周四登場的川習會營造樂觀氣氛。 IG首席市場分析師Alexandre Baradez表示，美中談判傳出的回饋，正為本周市場塑造正面敘事，但油價仍是左右行情的最關鍵因素。油氣價格下跌，加上科技股走強，帶動歐洲Stoxx 600指數上漲，歐洲公債表現也優於其他市場。

news.Title: SanDisk Corp’s (SNDK) Impact on Small/Mid Cap Returns
news.Content:
Riverwater Partners, an investment management company, released its 'Sustainable Value Strategy' Q2 2026 investor letter. The letter can be downloaded here . Small-cap stocks achieved their best first-half performance since 1991, with the Russell 2500 Value Index rising 17%, driven by the technology sector. The Sustainable Value Strategy underperformed its benchmark in the second quarter. The shortfall was driven almost entirely by stock selection, particularly the absence of SanDisk (SNDK), which rose approximately 720% year to date and contributed an estimated 6% of the Russell 2500 Value Index's 2026 return. Technology became the strategy's largest overweight at 17%, largely because index reconstitution sharply reduced the benchmark's technology allocation. Looking ahead to 2026, the outlook for small-cap equities remains constructive due to improving monetary conditions and attractive valuations, despite a lack of anticipated rotation toward higher-quality businesses. The firm remains committed to disciplined, quality-focused investing; historically, quality prevails over the long term. Additionally, reviewing the Fund's top five holdings could help identify its best picks for 2026.

In its second-quarter 2026 investor letter, Riverwater Sustainable Value Strategy highlighted Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ: SNDK ). Sandisk Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells data storage devices and solutions using NAND flash technology in the United States and internationally. On September 18, 2026, Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) closed at $1,791.82 per share. Over the past month, Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) returned 20.01%, but its shares are up 1,640.98% over the past year. Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) has a market capitalization of $262.35 billion, and its stock has traded within a 52-week range of $90.22 to $2,354.39.

Riverwater Sustainable Value Strategy stated the following regarding Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

"Intellectual honesty requires us to address the primary driver of Russell 2500 Value performance in 2026 that was absent from our portfolio: Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK). Spun off from Western Digital in February 2025, this NAND flash memory company appreciated approximately 720% year-to-date and roughly 4,000% over the trailing twelve months. At its peak, SanDisk comprised nearly 5% of the Russell 2500 Value Index and accounted for an estimated 6% of the index's year-to-date 2026 return. All driven by a single stock. The fundamental story is real. AI data centers require enormous quantities of high-performance NAND flash storage.

We did not own SanDisk. Memory semiconductors remain a cyclical commodity business. NAND pricing is dictated by supply and demand at the industry level rather than individual competitive advantages, effectively rendering producers price-takers rather than price makers. Historically, these companies have earned poor returns on invested capital across the cycle, punctuated by concentrated bursts of enormous profitability when supply is tight. SanDisk in 2026 is in the tight-supply period. SanDisk also exceeded our market capitalization threshold, starting the year above $40 billion — well outside our investable range. By the time it was reconstituted out of the Russell 2500 Value Index at the end of the quarter, its market cap had surged past $250 billion. We believe it is more important to maintain discipline regarding our mandate than to compromise our investment framework simply to avoid the discomfort of short-term underperformance."

Story Continues

Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ: SNDK ) is not on our list of the  40 Most Popular Stocks Among Hedge Funds . As per our database, 128 hedge fund portfolios held Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ: SNDK ) at the end of the second quarter which was 114 in the previous quarter. While we acknowledge the potential of Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: SoftBank Seeks $11 Billion in What Would Be a Record Junk Bond Sale
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

SoftBank Group Corp. is seeking more than $11 billion equivalent in bonds, Bloomberg reported , citing people familiar with the matter, in what would be one of the largest junk bond deals ever by a single firm outside a distressed exchange. The plan is $10 billion of dollar notes across three tenors and 1 billion of euro notes across two. Proceeds partly fund a follow-on OpenAI investment expected to close next month.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 4 Warning Sign with NVO.

Is ARM fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

SoftBank has committed close to $65 billion to OpenAI and has been raising debt on multiple fronts at once. It closed last week with nearly $21 billion of fresh potential borrowing: a $5 billion increase to its Arm ( NASDAQ:ARM ) backed margin loan, taking that facility to $25 billion, and $450 million added to an existing credit line, now $6.5 billion. Apollo Global Management Inc. ( NYSE:APO ) is discussing raising a separate loan to SoftBank by $3.6 billion to $9 billion, on top of an $11.87 billion loan secured this month. It has sold almost $15 billion of notes across currencies this year, the most of any junk-rated borrower.

SoftBank's 2031 dollar bond yield climbed to 8.2% this month from as low as 6.7% in January. The cost to insure its debt against default hit a three-year high as concerns about an AI slowdown intensified, after Anthropic's Dario Amodei and other AI leaders called for slowing model development. SoftBank carries a BB+ rating from S&P, its highest speculative grade, against AA+ and AA for Alphabet ( NASDAQ:GOOGL ) and Amazon ( NASDAQ:AMZN ), the two largest corporate bond issuers of 2026.
